10100247.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 这是一个反常积分,可以按定积分那样作变量变换.令 \(\sqrt{\frac{1 - x}{1 + x}} = t\), \(x \to -1^{+}\) 时 \(t \to +\infty\); \(x = 1\) 时 \(t = 0\). \(x = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\), \(\mathrm{d}x = \frac{-4t}{(1 + t^2)^2}\mathrm{d}t\),
\[
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \sqrt {\frac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {0} \frac {- 4 t ^ {2}}{(1 + t ^ {2}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{1 + t ^ {2}}\right)
\]
\[
= - 2 \left(\frac {t}{1 + t ^ {2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t\right)
\]
\[
= - 2 \left(0 - \arctan t \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty}\right) = \pi .
\]
方法2 由 \(\int_{+\infty}^{0} \frac{-4t^2}{(1 + t^2)^2} \mathrm{d}t\) 作变量变换, 命 \(t = \tan u\), 有 \(\mathrm{d}t = \sec^2 u \mathrm{d}u\), 当 \(t = 0\) 时 \(u = 0\), 当 \(t \to +\infty\) 时 \(u \to \frac{\pi}{2}\).
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \sqrt {\frac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {0} \frac {- 4 t ^ {2}}{(1 + t ^ {2}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {0} \frac {- 4 \tan^ {2} u}{\sec^ {4} u} \cdot \sec^ {2} u \mathrm{d} u \\ = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} u d u = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (2 - 2 \cos 2 u) d u \\ = (2 u - \sin 2 u) \left| _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} = \pi . \right. \\ \end{array}
\]

10100248.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi}x|\cos x|\sin x\mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}x\cos x\sin x\mathrm{d}x - \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}x\cos x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\)
\[
\begin{array}{l} = - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} x d \cos 2 x + \frac {1}{4} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} x d \cos 2 x \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x \cos 2 x \left| _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} + \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos 2 x d x + \frac {1}{4} x \cos 2 x \right| _ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \cos 2 x d x \\ = \frac {\pi}{8} + \frac {\pi}{4} + \frac {\pi}{8} = \frac {\pi}{2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
方法2 \(I = \frac{x = t + \frac{\pi}{2}}{2}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(t + \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\sqrt{\cos^2\left(t + \frac{\pi}{2}\right) - \cos^4\left(t + \frac{\pi}{2}\right)}\mathrm{d}t\)
\[
= 0 + \frac {\pi}{2} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {\sin^ {2} t - \sin^ {4} t} d t
\]
\[
= \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin t \cos t d t = \frac {\pi}{2} \sin^ {2} t \Big | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} = \frac {\pi}{2}.
\]
方法3 \(\int_0^\pi x\sqrt{\cos^2x - \cos^4x}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{2}\int_0^\pi \sqrt{\cos^2x - \cos^4x}\mathrm{d}x = \pi \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sqrt{\cos^2x - \cos^4x}\mathrm{d}x\)
\[
= \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin x \cos x d x = \frac {\pi}{2}.
\]
【评注】若函数 \( f(x) \) 在 \( [0,1] \) 上连续，则有
(1) \(\int_{0}^{\pi} xf(\sin x) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi} f(\sin x) \mathrm{d}x\);
(2) \(\int_{0}^{\pi} f(\sin x) \, \mathrm{d}x = 2 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f(\sin x) \, \mathrm{d}x.\)

10100251.analysis_md:
【分析】作积分变量变换,令 \( 2x - t = u \) , 原等式化为
\[
2 x \int_ {x} ^ {2 x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u - \int_ {x} ^ {2 x} u f (u) \mathrm{d} u = \frac {1}{2} \ln (1 + x ^ {2}),
\]
两边对 \(x\) 求导，得
\[
2 \int_ {x} ^ {2 x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u - x f (x) = \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}},
\]
令 \(x = 1\) 代入得 \(2\int_{1}^{2}f(u)\mathrm{d}u = f(1) + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2}\) 所以 \(\int_{1}^{2}f(u)\mathrm{d}u = \frac{3}{4}.\)
【评注】上、下限都是变量时的变限积分函数求导定理如下：“设 \(f(x)\) 连续，\(\varphi_2(x)\) 与 \(\varphi_1(x)\) 均可导，则
\[
\left[ \int_ {\varphi_ {1} (x)} ^ {\varphi_ {2} (x)} f (u) \mathrm{d} u \right] _ {x} ^ {\prime} = f [ \varphi_ {2} (x) ] \varphi_ {2} ^ {\prime} (x) - f [ \varphi_ {1} (x) ] \varphi_ {1} ^ {\prime} (x). \tag {*}
\]
由
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {\varphi_ {1} (x)} ^ {\varphi_ {2} (x)} f (u) \mathrm{d} u = \int_ {a} ^ {\varphi_ {2} (x)} f (u) \mathrm{d} u + \int_ {\varphi_ {1} (x)} ^ {a} f (u) \mathrm{d} u \\ = \int_ {a} ^ {\varphi_ {2} (x)} f (u) \mathrm{d} u - \int_ {0} ^ {\varphi_ {1} (x)} f (u) \mathrm{d} u \\ \end{array}
\]
即可获得（*）的证明.

10100252.analysis_md:
【分析】因 \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{|x|}\sin 2x\mathrm{d}x = \int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^x\sin 2x\mathrm{d}x = \frac{\mathrm{e}^x(\sin 2x - 2\cos 2x)}{5}\Bigg|_{0}^{+\infty}\)
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} (\sin 2 x - 2 \cos 2 x)}{5} + \frac {2}{5}.
\]
又因 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^x(\sin 2x - 2\cos 2x)}{5}\) 不存在，所以 \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{|x|}\sin 2x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散，因此 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{|x|}\sin 2x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散.

10100250.analysis_md:
【分析】 先求 \(F^{\prime}(x) = \int_{0}^{x^{2}}\ln (1 + t^{2})\mathrm{d}t,\)
再求 \(F''(x) = 2x\ln (1 + x^4)\left\{ \begin{array}{ll} > 0, & x > 0,\\ = 0, & x = 0,\\ < 0, & x < 0, \end{array} \right.\)
则 \(y = F(x)\) 在区间 \((- \infty, 0)\) 上是凸的，在区间 \((0, +\infty)\) 上是凹的。因此，选(B).

10100249.analysis_md:
【分析】 \( M=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{(1+x)^{2}}{1+x^{2}}dx=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1+x^{2}+2x}{1+x^{2}}dx=\pi; \)
因为 \(\mathrm{e}^x\geqslant 1 + x,N = \int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1 + x}{\mathrm{e}^x}\mathrm{d}x < \pi ;\)
又因为 \(1 + \sqrt{\cos x} \geqslant 1, x \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right), K = \int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (1 + \sqrt{\cos x}) \mathrm{d}x > \pi\)，故 \(K > M > N\).

10100253.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty}\left[\frac{x^2 + bx + 1}{x(x + 2)} -1\right]\mathrm{d}x = \int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{(b - 2)x + 1}{x(x + 2)}\mathrm{d}x.\)
若 \(b \neq 2\). 则由
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ x \cdot \frac {(b - 2) x + 1}{x (x + 2)} \right] = b - 2 \neq 0
\]
知 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty}\left[\frac{x^2 + bx + 1}{x(x + 2)} -1\right]\mathrm{d}x\) 发散.由于题设收敛，所以只能 \(b = 2\)
取定 \(b = 2\) ，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ \frac {x ^ {2} + b x + 1}{x (x + 2)} - 1 \right] d x = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{x (x + 2)} d x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \left(\frac {1}{x} - \frac {1}{x + 2}\right) d x \\ = \frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {x}{x + 2} \Big | _ {1} ^ {+ \infty} = - \frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {1}{3} = \frac {1}{2} \ln 3. \\ \end{array}
\]
选(B).
【评注】也可以不用判别法,直接计算积分:
\[
\int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {(b - 2) x + 1}{x (x + 2)} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {(b - 2) x}{(x (x + 2)} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {1}{x (x + 2)} \mathrm{d} x \right].
\]
对于前一反常积分, 若 \( b \neq 2 \) ,
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {(b - 2) x}{x (x + 2)} \mathrm{d} x = (b - 2) \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x + 2} \\ = (b - 2) \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} [ \ln (t + 2) - \ln 3 ] = \infty (\text {发散}). \\ \end{array}
\]
对于后一反常积分，
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x (x + 2)} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {x}{x + 2} \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {t} \\ = \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \left(\frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {t}{t + 2} - \frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {1}{3}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \ln 3. \\ \end{array}
\]
所以当 \(b \neq 2\) 时原反常积分发散. 当 \(b = 2\) 时, 前一积分为零, 后一积分为 \(\frac{1}{2} \ln 3\). 选(B).

10100254.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 \(x = 0\) 是(A)的瑕点.
\[
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {1}{\sin x} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} \frac {1}{\sin x} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{\sin x} \mathrm{d} x,
\]
以 \(\int_0^1\frac{1}{\sin x}\mathrm{d}x\) 为例.
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{\sin x} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{2 \tan \frac {x}{2} \cos^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} \left(\tan \frac {x}{2}\right)}{\tan \frac {x}{2}} \\ = \ln \tan \frac {x}{2} \Big | _ {0 ^ {+}} ^ {1} = \infty . \\ \end{array}
\]
所以 \(\int_0^1\frac{1}{\sin x}\mathrm{d}x\) 发散，从而知 \(\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{1}{\sin x}\mathrm{d}x\) 发散.选(A).
方法 2 用比较判别法，
因 \(x \to 0\) 时 \(\sin x \sim x \Rightarrow \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{\sin x} / \frac{1}{x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x}{\sin x} = 1\).
又 \(\int_0^1\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x}\) 发散，由比较判别法的极限形式 \(\Rightarrow \int_0^1\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\sin x}\) 发散，从而知 \(\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\sin x}\) 发散.选(A).
方法3 (B) \(\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}} = \arcsin x\bigg|_{-1}^{1} = \pi .\)
(C) \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-x^2}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}.\)
(D) \(\int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\ln^2x} = \int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln x}{\ln^2x} = -\frac{1}{\ln x}\bigg|_{2}^{+\infty} = \frac{1}{\ln 2}.\)
因此(B)(C)(D)均收敛,选(A).

10100256.analysis_md:
【分析】直接求出定积分办不到. 我们用适当放大缩小法.
\[
\int_ {1} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \leqslant \int_ {1} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \frac {\sqrt [ n ]{x}}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \leqslant 3 ^ {\frac {1}{2 n}} \int_ {1} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}},
\]
注意 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}3^{\frac{1}{2n}} = 1\) ，由夹逼定理，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \frac {\sqrt [ n ]{x} \mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}} = \int_ {1} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \\ = \arctan x \left| _ {1} ^ {\sqrt {3}} = \frac {\pi}{3} - \frac {\pi}{4} = \frac {\pi}{1 2}. \right. \\ \end{array}
\]
选(B).

10100255.analysis_md:
【分析】由于 \(\int \left[\frac{1}{x\ln^2x} -\frac{k}{(x - 1)^2}\right]\mathrm{d}x = -\frac{1}{\ln x} +\frac{k}{x - 1} +C,\) 所以
\(\int_{1}^{2}\left[\frac{1}{x\ln^2x} -\frac{k}{(x - 1)^2}\right]\mathrm{d}x\) 收敛当且仅当 \(\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}\left(-\frac{1}{\ln x} +\frac{k}{x - 1}\right)\) 存在.
结合泰勒定理,注意到
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \left(- \frac {1}{\ln x} + \frac {k}{x - 1}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {k \ln x - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) \ln x} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {k \ln (1 + x - 1) - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) \ln (1 + x - 1)} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {k [ (x - 1) - \frac {(x - 1) ^ {2}}{2} + o ((x - 1) ^ {2}) ] - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) ^ {2}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {(k - 1) (x - 1) - \frac {k (x - 1) ^ {2}}{2} + o ((x - 1) ^ {2})}{(x - 1) ^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
\]
综上可得, 极限 \(\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}\left(-\frac{1}{\ln x} +\frac{k}{x - 1}\right)\) 存在当且仅当 \(k = 1\) ，从而当 \(k = 1\) 时，反常积分 \(\int_1^2\left[\frac{1}{x\ln^2x} -\frac{k}{(x - 1)^2}\right]\mathrm{d}x\) 收敛，选择(A).

10100260.analysis_md:
【分析】 区域 \(D\) 的面积
\[
S = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\sin x - \frac {2}{\pi} x\right) \mathrm{d} x = 1 - \frac {2}{\pi} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4} = 1 - \frac {\pi}{4}.
\]
区域 D 绕 x 轴旋转一周所得旋转体体积
\[
\begin{array}{l} V _ {x} = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \pi \sin^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \pi \left(\frac {2 x}{\pi}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \pi \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2} - \frac {4}{\pi} \cdot \frac {1}{3} \cdot \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) ^ {3} = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{1 2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
因此选择(C).

10100261.analysis_md:
【分析】由旋转曲面求面积公式 \(S = 2\pi \int_{a}^{b}|y|\sqrt{1 + (y')^2}\mathrm{d}x.\)
可得所求面积为
\[
\begin{array}{l} S = 2 \pi \int_ {1} ^ {2} 2 \sqrt {x - 1} \cdot \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {x - 1}}\right) ^ {2}} d x \\ = 4 \pi \int_ {1} ^ {2} \sqrt {x} d x = \frac {8 \pi}{3} x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {2} = \frac {8 \pi}{3} (2 \sqrt {2} - 1). \\ \end{array}
\]
故应选(B).

10100257.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(a_{n} = 3\cdot \frac{1}{2n}\int_{0}^{\frac{n + 1}{n}}(1 + x^{2n})^{\frac{1}{2}}\mathrm{d}(1 + x^{2n})\)
\[
= 3 \cdot \frac {1}{2 n} \cdot \frac {2}{3} (1 + x ^ {2 n}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {n + 1}{n}}
\]
\[
= \frac {1}{n} \left[ \left(1 + \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {2 n}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - 1 \right]
\]
因 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n = \mathrm{e}\) ，所以 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}na_n = (1 + \mathrm{e}^2)^{\frac{3}{2}} - 1.\) 因此选(B).

10100258.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(|\sin x|\) 以 \(\pi\) 为周期，它在每个周期上的积分相等，又 \(\int_0^\pi |\sin x|\mathrm{d}x = 2\) ，因此当 \(n\pi \leqslant x\leqslant (n + 1)\pi\)
\[
2 n = \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} | \sin x | d x \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {x} | \sin x | d x \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {(n + 1) \pi} | \sin x | d x = 2 (n + 1),
\]
所以有 \(\frac{2n}{(n + 1)\pi} \leqslant \frac{\int_0^x |\sin x| \, \mathrm{d}x}{x} \leqslant \frac{2(n + 1)}{n\pi}\).
注意, \( x\rightarrow+\infty\Leftrightarrow n\rightarrow\infty \) .在上式中,令 \( n\rightarrow\infty \) ,得
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} | \sin x | \mathrm{d} x}{x} = \frac {2}{\pi}.
\]
因此选(C).
【评注】 在本题的解答中,要注意以下两点:
(1) 如果 \(f(x)\) 是以 \(T\) 为周期的连续函数, 则 \(\int_{a}^{a + T} f(x) \mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{T} f(x) \mathrm{d}x\).
(2) 当 \( f(x) \geqslant 0 \) 时, 当 \( x > y > a \) 时就有 \( \int_{a}^{x} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t \geqslant \int_{a}^{y} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t. \)

10100262.analysis_md:
【分析】设切点坐标为 \((x_0, y_0)\)，于是切线斜率为 \(2x_0\)，切线方程为
\[
y - y _ {0} = 2 x _ {0} (x - x _ {0}),
\]
将 \(x = 0, y = 0\) 代入，得 \(y_0 = 2x_0^2\). 又因点 \((x_0, y_0)\) 在曲线 \(C\) 上，有 \(y_0 = x_0^2 + 1\). 解得切点坐标为 \((\pm 1, 2)\). 切线方程为 \(y = \pm 2x\)，见右图. 求 \(V\) 有两个方法.
![](images/0.jpg)
方法1 以 \(y\) 为自变量, 曲线表示为 \(x = \sqrt{y - 1}, x = \frac{1}{2} y, V\) 是两旋转体体积相减:
\[
V = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {2} \left(\frac {y}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y - \pi \int_ {1} ^ {2} (y - 1) \mathrm{d} y = \frac {\pi}{6}.
\]
方法2 以 \(x\) 为自变量, 曲线表示为 \(y = x^{2} + 1, y = 2x\). 任取 \([x, x + \mathrm{d}x] \subset [0, 1]\) 对应的小竖窄条, 高 \(x^{2} + 1 - 2x\), 相应的体积微元 \(\mathrm{d}V = 2\pi x(x^{2} + 1 - 2x)\mathrm{d}x\), 于是
\[
V = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} x (x ^ {2} + 1 - 2 x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{6} \pi .
\]

10100259.analysis_md:
【分析】先求 \(y = \cos x\) 与 \(y = a\sin x\) 的交点的横坐标 \(x_0\).
由 \(\cos x_0 = a\sin x_0\Rightarrow \tan x_0 = \frac{1}{a}.\)
因 \(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos x\mathrm{d}x = \sin x\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} = 1\) ，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} (\cos x - a \sin x) \mathrm{d} x = (\sin x + a \cos x) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} = \sin x _ {0} + a \cos x _ {0} - a \\ = (\tan x _ {0} + a) \cos x _ {0} - a = \left(\frac {1}{a} + a\right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \tan^ {2} x _ {0}}} - a \\ \end{array}
\]
\[
= \frac {1 + a ^ {2}}{a} \cdot \frac {a}{\sqrt {1 + a ^ {2}}} - a = \sqrt {1 + a ^ {2}} - a = \frac {1}{2}.
\]
由 \(\sqrt{1 + a^2} - a = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow \sqrt{1 + a^2} + a = 2\)，易得 \(a = \frac{3}{4}\).
选(C).

10100263.analysis_md:
【分析】把曲线表成 \(x = x(y)\)，要分成两条：
\[
x = 1 \pm \sqrt {1 - y} (0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1)
\]
看成两个旋转体的体积之差：
\[
V _ {1} = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 + \sqrt {1 - y}) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y, V _ {2} = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - \sqrt {1 - y}) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y.
\]
![](images/0.jpg)
于是 \(V = V_{1} - V_{2} = \pi \int_{0}^{1}[(1 + \sqrt{1 - y})^{2} - (1 - \sqrt{1 - y})^{2}]\mathrm{d}y\) ，因此选(D).
【评注】（1）按公式计算得
\[
V = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} 4 \sqrt {1 - y} \mathrm{d} y = 4 \pi \left(- \frac {2}{3} (1 - y) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {8}{3} \pi .
\]
(2) 也可利用另一旋转体体积公式.
设 \(b > a \geqslant 0\)，曲线 \(y = f(x) (a \leqslant x \leqslant b)\) 与直线 \(x = a, x = b\) 及 \(x\) 轴围成图形绕 \(y\) 轴旋转所得旋转体的体积 \(V = \int_{a}^{b} 2\pi x f(x) \mathrm{d}x\)
我们也可求出
\[
V = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {2} x [ 1 - (x - 1) ^ {2} ] \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {2} x (2 x - x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi \left(\frac {2}{3} x ^ {3} - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {4}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {8}{3} \pi .
\]

10100265.analysis_md:

10100270.analysis_md:
【分析】齐次微分方程 \( y'' - 2y' + 5y = 0 \) 的特征方程是 \( \lambda^{2} - 2\lambda + 5 = 0 \) ，特征根是 \( \lambda_{1} = 1 + 2i, \lambda_{2} = 1 - 2i \) .
按照选取特解的规则应设非齐次微分方程 \( y'' - 2y' + 5y = e^x\cos 2x \) 具有形式为 \( y^* = xe^x (a\cos 2x + b\sin 2x) \) 的特解，其中 \( a \) 与 \( b \) 是待定常数.
记 \(y_{1} = \mathrm{e}^{x}\cos 2x, y_{2} = \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin 2x\)，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} y ^ {\bullet} = x \left(a y _ {1} + b y _ {2}\right), \\ y ^ {\bullet^ {\prime}} = x \left(a y _ {1} ^ {\prime} + b y _ {2} ^ {\prime}\right) + \left(a y _ {1} + b y _ {2}\right), \\ y ^ {\bullet \prime \prime} = x \left(a y _ {1} ^ {\prime \prime} + b y _ {2} ^ {\prime \prime}\right) + 2 \left(a y _ {1} ^ {\prime} + b y _ {2} ^ {\prime}\right), \\ \end{array}
\]
从而
\[
\begin{array}{l} y ^ {\prime \prime} - 2 y ^ {\prime} + 5 y ^ {\prime} \\ = x \left[ a \left(y _ {1} ^ {\prime \prime} - 2 y _ {1} ^ {\prime} + 5 y _ {1}\right) + b \left(y _ {2} ^ {\prime \prime} - 2 y _ {2} ^ {\prime} + 5 y _ {2}\right) \right] + 2 a \left(y _ {1} ^ {\prime} - y _ {1}\right) + 2 b \left(y _ {2} ^ {\prime} - y _ {2}\right) \\ = 2 a \left(y _ {1} ^ {\prime} - y _ {1}\right) + 2 b \left(y _ {2} ^ {\prime} - y _ {2}\right) \\ = 2 a e ^ {x} (\cos 2 x - 2 \sin 2 x - \cos 2 x) + 2 b e ^ {x} (\sin 2 x + 2 \cos 2 x - \sin 2 x) \\ = - 4 a e ^ {x} \sin 2 x + 4 b e ^ {x} \cos 2 x. \\ \end{array}
\]
要使 \( y^{*} \) 是方程的特解, 待定系数应满足 \( a = 0, b = \frac{1}{4} \) , 即微分方程
\[
y ^ {\prime \prime} - 2 y ^ {\prime} + 5 y = \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \cos 2 x
\]
有特解为
\[
y ^ {\bullet} = \frac {1}{4} x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \sin 2 x.
\]
故应选(D).

10100266.analysis_md:
【分析】解线性方程 \(xf'(x) = f(x) + \frac{3}{2} ax^2\) 得
\[
f (x) = C x + \frac {3}{2} a x ^ {2}.
\]
由题设知
\[
2 = \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(C x + \frac {3}{2} a x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {C}{2} + \frac {a}{2},
\]
则
\[
C = 4 - a.
\]
\[
f (x) = (4 - a) x + \frac {3}{2} a x ^ {2}.
\]

10100268.analysis_md:
【分析】微分方程对应的齐次微分方程是: \( y'' - 3y' + 2y = 0 \), 其特征方程为 \( \lambda^2 - 3\lambda + 2 = 0 \), 其特征根为 \( \lambda_1 = 1, \lambda_2 = 2 \).
因此微分方程 \( y'' - 3y' + 2y = -2e^{x} \) 有形如 \( y_{1}^{*} = cxe^{x} \) 的特解.
又微分方程 \( y'' - 3y' + 2y = 3x \) 有形如 \( y_2^* = ax + b \) 的特解. 所以, 由叠加原理知, 原方程 \( y'' - 3y' + 2y = 3x - 2e^x \) 有形如 \( y^* = y_1^* + y_2^* = cxe^x + (ax + b) \) 的特解, 应选(D).

10100269.analysis_md:
【分析】由题设知 \( y = y(x) \) 是 \( y'' - 6y' + 9y = \mathrm{e}^{3x} \) 满足 \( y(0) = 0, y'(0) = 2 \) 的特解.对应的特征方程为 \( \lambda^2 - 6\lambda + 9 = 0 \)，特征根 \( \lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = 3 \). 从而对应的齐次微分方程的通解为 \( y = C_1\mathrm{e}^{3x} + C_2x\mathrm{e}^{3x} \). 因非齐次项 \( f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{3x} \)，从而可设非齐次微分方程 \( y'' - 6y' + 9y = \mathrm{e}^{3x} \) 具有形式为 \( y^* = Ax^2\mathrm{e}^{3x} \) 的特解. 代入原方程可确定常数 \( A = \frac{1}{2} \)，即原方程的通解为
\[
y = \left(C _ {1} + C _ {2} x + \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm{e} ^ {3 x}.
\]
由 \(y(0) = 0, y'(0) = 2\) 可确定 \(C_1 = 0, C_2 = 2\). 故所求曲线的方程为
\[
y = \left(2 x + \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm{e} ^ {3 x} = \frac {x}{2} (x + 4) \mathrm{e} ^ {3 x}.
\]
应选(C).
【评注】按选项特点((A)(B)(D)中均含三角函数),求出特征根 \(\lambda_{1} = \lambda_{2} = 3\),写出通解形式 \(y = C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{3x} + C_{2}x\mathrm{e}^{3x} + Ax^{2}\mathrm{e}^{3x}\) 后不必再计算就可选(C).

10100273.analysis_md:
【分析】当 \(x \geqslant 2\) 时将题设的等式两边对 \(x\) 求导数，得
\[
g [ f (x) ] f ^ {\prime} (x) = x ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 x f (x) + 1, \tag {*}
\]
由于 \(g[f(x)] \equiv x\)，从 \((\ast)\) 式又可得
\[
\begin{array}{l} x f ^ {\prime} (x) = x ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 x f (x) + 1 \\ \Leftrightarrow (x ^ {2} - x) f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 x f (x) = - 1 \\ \Leftrightarrow (x - 1) f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 f (x) = - \frac {1}{x} \\ \Leftrightarrow (x - 1) ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 (x - 1) f (x) = \frac {1}{x} - 1 \\ \Leftrightarrow [ (x - 1) ^ {2} f (x) ] ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{x} - 1. \tag {***} \\ \end{array}
\]
将( \( * \) \( * \) )式两边在区间[2,4]上求定积分,并利用 \( f(2)=1 \) 就有
\[
\begin{array}{l} (x - 1) ^ {2} f (x) \left| _ {2} ^ {4} = \int_ {2} ^ {4} \left(\frac {1}{x} - 1\right) d x \right. \\ \Leftrightarrow 9 f (4) - f (2) = \ln x \left| _ {2} ^ {4} - 2 \right. \\ \Leftrightarrow f (4) = \frac {1}{9} (\ln 2 - 1). \\ \end{array}
\]
故应选(D).

10100272.analysis_md:
【分析】这不是可分离变量方程、一阶线性方程,也不是齐次方程与伯努利方程,检验一下是否是全微分方程,方程表示成 \( P(x,y)\mathrm{d}x+Q(x,y)\mathrm{d}y=0 \) ,
\[
\frac {\partial P}{\partial y} = 2 y = \frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} (\text {在全平面}),
\]
因此该方程是全微分方程,归结为求 \( u(x,y) \) 使得
\[
\mathrm{d} u = P \mathrm{d} x + Q \mathrm{d} y.
\]
方法 1 （观察法即凑微分法）
原方程改写成
\[
(y ^ {2} - 1) \mathrm{d} x + x \mathrm{d} (y ^ {2} - 1) - \mathrm{d} \sin y = 0,
\]
\[
\mathrm{d} \left[ (y ^ {2} - 1) x - \sin y \right] = 0,
\]
因此通解为
\[
(y ^ {2} - 1) x - \sin y = C.
\]
选(D).
方法 2 （不定积分法）
归结为求 \(u(x,y)\) ，使得 \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = P = y^2 -1,\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = Q = 2xy - \cos y.\)
将第一式对 \(x\) 积分得
\[
u = (y ^ {2} - 1) x + C (y).
\]
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = 2 x y + C ^ {\prime} (y) = 2 x y - \cos y, C ^ {\prime} (y) = - \cos y, C (y) = - \sin y + C.
\]
\[
u (x, y) = (y ^ {2} - 1) x - \sin y + C.
\]
通解为 \( (y^{2}-1)x-\sin y=C. \) 选(D).
方法 3 （特殊路径积分法）
取特殊路径,如右图折线路径,
\[
\begin{array}{l} u (x, y) = \int_ {(0, 0)} ^ {(x, y)} P \mathrm{d} x + Q \mathrm{d} y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {x} P (x, 0) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {y} Q (x, y) \mathrm{d} y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {x} (- 1) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {y} (2 x y - \cos y) \mathrm{d} y \\ = - x + x y ^ {2} - \sin y = x (y ^ {2} - 1) - \sin y. \\ \end{array}
\]
通解为 \(x(y^{2} - 1) - \sin y = C.\) 选(D).

10100275.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 由二阶线性微分方程解的性质与结构知,相应的齐次方程 \( y'' + ay' + by = 0 \) 有两个线性无关的解: \( y_1 = e^{-2x}, y_2 = e^x \), 于是相应的特征根是 \( \lambda_1 = -2, \lambda_2 = 1 \), 特征方程是
\[
(\lambda + 2) (\lambda - 1) = 0, \text {即} \lambda^ {2} + \lambda - 2 = 0,
\]
故 \(a = 1, b = -2\).
\( y^{*} = x^{2}e^{x} \) 是方程 \( y'' + y' - 2y = (cx + d)e^{x} \) 的解，
\[
y ^ {\prime \prime} = (x ^ {2} + 2 x) \mathrm{e} ^ {x}, y ^ {\prime \prime \prime} = (x ^ {2} + 4 x + 2) \mathrm{e} ^ {x},
\]
代入得 \(y^{\prime \prime \prime} + y^{*\prime} - 2y^{*} = (6x + 2)\mathrm{e}^{x} = (cx + d)\mathrm{e}^{x},\)
求得 \(c = 6, d = 2\).
因此选(A).
方法2 把 \( y^{*} = \mathrm{e}^{-2x} + (x^{2} + 2)\mathrm{e}^{x}, (y^{*})' = -2\mathrm{e}^{-2x} + (x^{2} + 2x + 2)\mathrm{e}^{x}, (y^{*})'' = 4\mathrm{e}^{-2x} + (x^{2} + 4x + 4)\mathrm{e}^{x} \) 代入微分方程可得
\[
\begin{array}{l} (y ^ {*}) ^ {\prime \prime} + a (y ^ {*}) ^ {\prime} + b y ^ {*} \\ = (4 - 2 a + b) \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 x} + (1 + a + b) x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + (4 + 2 a) x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + (4 + 2 a + 2 b) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \\ \stackrel {\text {令}} {=} (c x + d) \mathrm{e} ^ {x}, \\ \end{array}
\]
就有 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l}4 - 2a + b = 0,\\ 1 + a + b = 0,\\ 4 + 2a = c,\\ 4 + 2a + 2b = d. \end{array} \right.\)
不难由前两个方程求得 \(a = 1, b = -2\)，把它们代入后两个方程又可得到 \(c = 6, d = 2\)，故应选(A).

10100277.analysis_md:
【分析】 对于欧拉方程
\[
x ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} + p \cdot x \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} + q y = 0 (p, q \text {为常数}),
\]
作自变量替换
\[
x = \mathrm{e} ^ {t},
\]
则原方程化为二阶线性常系数方程
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} + (p - 1) \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + q y = 0,
\]
对该题即化为
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} + \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - 2 y = 0.
\]
特征方程与特征根为 \(\lambda^2 +\lambda -2 = 0,\lambda_1 = -2,\lambda_2 = 1\)
通解为 \(y = C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{-2t} + C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{t}.\)
即 \(y = \frac{C_1}{x^2} + C_2x.\)

10100276.analysis_md:
【分析】由 \( y_{1} = \mathrm{e}^{-x}, y_{2} = 2x\mathrm{e}^{-x}, y_{3} = 3\mathrm{e}^{x} \) 是所求方程的三个特解知，\( \lambda = -1, -1, 1 \) 为所求三阶常系数线性齐次微分方程的特征方程的三个根，则其特征方程为
\[
(\lambda - 1) (\lambda + 1) ^ {2} = 0.
\]
即 \(\lambda^3 +\lambda^2 -\lambda -1 = 0.\)
对应的微分方程为 \(y''' + y'' - y' - y = 0.\)
故应选(B).

10100274.analysis_md:
【分析】一阶线性微分方程 \(xy' - 2y = -4x\) 可化为标准形式 \(y' - \frac{2}{x} y = -4\)，这是一阶线性微分方程，由线性方程通解公式得，
\[
y = \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {2}{x} \mathrm{d} x} \left(\int \mathrm{e} ^ {\int - \frac {2}{x} \mathrm{d} x} (- 4) \mathrm{d} x + C\right),
\]
于是得通解为 \( y = Cx^2 + 4x \). 由于对任何常数 \( C \) 都有 \( y(0) = 0 \), 从而曲线 \( y = Cx^2 + 4x \) 与直线 \( x = 1 \) 以及 \( x \) 轴所围成的平面图形绕 \( x \) 轴旋转一周所得旋转体的体积为
\[
\begin{array}{l} V (C) = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} y ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} (C x ^ {2} + 4 x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} (C ^ {2} x ^ {4} + 8 C x ^ {3} + 1 6 x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = \pi \left(\frac {C ^ {2}}{5} + 2 C + \frac {1 6}{3}\right). \\ \end{array}
\]
8
由于
\[
V ^ {\prime} (C) = \pi \left(\frac {2 C}{5} + 2\right) \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} < 0, & C < - 5, \\ = 0, & C = - 5, \\ > 0, & C > - 5. \end{array} \right.
\]
可见当 C = -5 时 \( V(C) \) 最小, 即函数 \( f(x) = 4x - 5x^{2} \) ,

10100278.analysis_md:
【分析】二阶常系数线性微分方程 \( y'' - y = x^2 \) 的特征方程与特征根分别是 \( \lambda^2 - 1 = 0 \) 与 \( \lambda_1 = 1, \lambda_2 = -1 \). 又方程有形式为 \( y' = Ax^2 + Bx + C \) 的特解，代入方程得
\[
2 A - (A x ^ {2} + B x + C) = x ^ {2},
\]
于是可确定 \(A = -1, B = 0, C = 2A = -2\). 故方程 \(y'' - y = x^2\) 的通解为
\[
y = C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - x ^ {2} - 2.
\]
为了得到符合题目要求的解 \(\varphi(x)\), 只需从条件
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - x ^ {2} - 2}{x ^ {2}} = 0 \Leftrightarrow \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2}{x ^ {2}} = 1
\]
中确定其中的常数 \(C_1\) 和 \(C_2\). 利用极限的四则运算法则有
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} (C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2}{x ^ {2}}\right) \cdot x ^ {a t} = 1 \cdot 0 = 0, & ① \\ \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2}{x ^ {2}} \cdot x = 1 \cdot 0 = 0, & ② \end{array} \right.
\]
于是有
\[
0 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} (C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2) = C _ {1} + C _ {2} - 2,
\]
即 \(C_1 + C_2 = 2\) ，把它代入上面 ② 式又有
\[
\begin{array}{l} 0 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - C _ {1} - C _ {2}}{x} \\ = C _ {1} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1}{x} + C _ {2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 1}{x} = C _ {1} - C _ {2}, \\ \end{array}
\]
即 \(C_1 = C_2\)。综合即得 \(C_1 = C_2 = 1\)。故可求得解 \(\varphi(x) = \mathrm{e}^x + \mathrm{e}^{-x} - x^2 - 2\)。
【评注】 直接计算可得
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\varphi (x)}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - x ^ {2} - 2}{x ^ {2}} = - 1 + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} - 2}{x ^ {2}} \\ = - 1 + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{2 x} = - 1 + \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} (\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}) = 0. \\ \end{array}
\]
即 \( \varphi(x) \) 确实是符合题目要求的特解。

10100279.analysis_md:
【分析】线性常系数齐次微分方程 \( y''-2y'+y=0 \) 的特征方程为 \( \lambda^{2}-2\lambda+1=0 \) ，特征值为 \( \lambda=1 \) （二重），所以微分方程 \( y''-2y'+y=0 \) 的通解为 \( y=C_{1}e^{x}+C_{2}xe^{x} \) .
微分方程 \( y''-2y'+y=0 \) 满足 \( y(0)=1,y'(0)=2 \) 的解为 \( y=e^{x}+xe^{x} \) .
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} y} = \frac {1}{\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}} = \frac {1}{2 \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}},
\]
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} x}{\mathrm{d} y ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} y} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} y}\right) = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} y} \left(\frac {1}{2 \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}\right) = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {1}{2 \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}\right) \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} y} = - \frac {3 \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{\left(2 \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}\right) ^ {3}}.
\]
多元函数微分学

10100281.analysis_md:
【分析】由于偏导数本质上就是一元函数的导数,则由 \( \frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}>0,\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial y}<0 \) 可知, \( f(x,y) \) 关于变量x是单调增加的,而关于变量y是单调减少的.
因此，当 \(x_{1} < x_{2}, y_{1} > y_{2}\) 时，
\[
f (x _ {1}, y _ {1}) < f (x _ {2}, y _ {1}), f (x _ {2}, y _ {1}) < f (x _ {2}, y _ {2}),
\]
从而有
\[
f (x _ {1}, y _ {1}) < f (x _ {2}, y _ {2}).
\]
故应选(D).

10100280.analysis_md:
【分析】 因为
\[
f \left(\frac {1}{y}, \frac {1}{x}\right) = \frac {x y - x ^ {2}}{x - 2 y} = \frac {\frac {1}{x} - \frac {1}{y}}{\frac {1}{x y} - \frac {2}{x ^ {2}}}.
\]
令 \(\frac{1}{y} = u, \frac{1}{x} = v\)，则 \(f(u, v) = \frac{v - u}{uv - 2v^2}\)，所以，\(f(x, y) = \frac{y - x}{xy - 2y^2}\). 故选(D).

10100284.analysis_md:
【分析】由 \(z = xf(x - y) + yg(x + y)\) 得
\[
\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = f + x f ^ {\prime} + y g ^ {\prime}, \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - x f ^ {\prime} + g + y g ^ {\prime},
\]
所以 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2} = f' + f' + xf'' + yg'' = 2f' + xf'' + yg''\)
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = x f ^ {\prime \prime} + g ^ {\prime} + g ^ {\prime} + y g ^ {\prime \prime} = x f ^ {\prime \prime} + 2 g ^ {\prime} + y g ^ {\prime \prime},
\]
故 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2} -\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y^2} = 2f' - 2g' = 2(f' - g')\) ，应选(A).

10100286.analysis_md:
【分析】显然 \(f(x,y) = 1 + x + y\) 在区域 \(x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant 1\) 内无驻点，令
\[
F (x, y, \lambda) = 1 + x + y + \lambda (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 1).
\]
令 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} F_{x}^{\prime} = 1 + 2\lambda x = 0, \\ F_{y}^{\prime} = 1 + 2\lambda y = 0, \\ F_{\lambda}^{\prime} = x^{2} + y^{2} - 1 = 0, \end{array} \right.\)
得 \(x = y = \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}.\)
有 \(f\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right) = 1 + \sqrt{2}\) 为最大值，\(f\left(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right) = 1 - \sqrt{2}\) 为最小值，\((1 + \sqrt{2})(1 - \sqrt{2}) = -1.\)
故应选(A).

10100283.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(z_{x}^{\prime} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}} f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - \frac{y\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}}{x^{2}} f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right),\)
\[
z _ {y} ^ {\prime} = \frac {y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) + \frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}}{x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right),
\]
\[
x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right),
\]
则 \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2} f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = \frac{2y^2}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}},\)
\[
f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) = \frac {2 y ^ {2}}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} = \frac {2 \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) ^ {2}}{1 + \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) ^ {2}},
\]
\[
f (x) = \frac {2 x ^ {2}}{1 + x ^ {2}}.
\]
则 \(f(1) = 1, f'(1) = 1\)，故应选(D).

10100287.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 按题设,存在某二元函数 \( u(x,y) \) ,
\[
\mathrm{d} u = [ f (x) - \mathrm{e} ^ {x} ] \sin y \mathrm{d} x - f (x) \cos y \mathrm{d} y
\]
即 \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = [f(x) - \mathrm{e}^x]\sin y,\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -f(x)\cos y.\)
由于 \(f(x)\) 有一阶连续导数, 可知 \(u(x, y)\) 有连续的二阶偏导数, 于是
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial y \partial x}
\]
即 \(\frac{\partial}{\partial x} (-f(x)\cos y) = \frac{\partial}{\partial y} ([f(x) - e^x]\sin y)\). 由此得 \(f'(x) + f(x) = e^x\)，解此方程得 \(f(x) = e^{-x}\left(\frac{1}{2} e^{2x} + C\right)\)，由 \(f(0) = 0\) 得 \(C = -\frac{1}{2}\)，故 \(f(x) = \frac{e^x - e^{-x}}{2}\).
应选（D）.
方法 2 按题设, 存在某二元函数 \( u(x, y) \) 使得
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = [ f (x) - \mathrm{e} ^ {x} ] \sin y \tag {①}
\]
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = - f (x) \cos y \tag {②}
\]
由式 ② 对 y 积分得
\[
u (x, y) = - f (x) \sin y + C (x)
\]
再对 \(x\) 求偏导数并由式 ① 得
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = - f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin y + C ^ {\prime} (x) = [ f (x) - e ^ {x} ] \sin y
\]
于是得
\[
[ f ^ {\prime} (x) + f (x) - \mathrm{e} ^ {x} ] \sin y - C ^ {\prime} (x) = 0
\]
即
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) + f (x) = \mathrm{e} ^ {x}, C (x) = C (\text {任意常数}).
\]
由此及 \(f(0) = 0\) 解得 \(f(x) = \frac{\mathrm{e}^x - \mathrm{e}^{-x}}{2}\), 选(D).

10100285.analysis_md:
【分析】利用一阶全微分形式不变性,将方程两边求全微分,可得
\[
3 (x \mathrm{d} y + y \mathrm{d} x) + 2 \mathrm{d} x - 4 \mathrm{d} y - \mathrm{d} z = \mathrm{e} ^ {z} \mathrm{d} z,
\]
由此可知
\[
\mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {z}} [ (2 + 3 y) \mathrm{d} x + (3 x - 4) \mathrm{d} y ],
\]
于是 \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{2 + 3y}{1 + \mathrm{e}^z},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{3x - 4}{1 + \mathrm{e}^z}\) 以及 \(\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)} = \frac{5}{2},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = -\frac{1}{2}.\)
继续求二阶混合偏导数 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}\) ，有
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac {\partial}{\partial y} \left(\frac {2 + 3 y}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {z}}\right) = \frac {3}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {z}} - \frac {2 + 3 y}{(1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {z}) ^ {2}} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {z} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y},
\]
在上式中令 \(x = 1, y = 1\)，并利用 \(z(1,1) = 0\) 与 \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = -\frac{1}{2}\) 即得
\[
\left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(1, 1)} = \frac {3}{2} - \frac {5}{4} \times \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {3}{2} + \frac {5}{8} = \frac {1 7}{8} = 2 \frac {1}{8}.
\]
故应选(B).

10100289.analysis_md:
【分析】由 \(\lim_{(x,y)\to (0,0)}f_x'(x,y) = f_x'(0,0)\) 和 \(\lim_{(x,y)\to (0,0)}f_y'(x,y) = f_y'(0,0)\) 可知， \(f(x,y)\) 的两个一阶偏导数 \(f_x'(x,y)\) 和 \(f_y'(x,y)\) 在(0,0)点处连续，则 \(f(x,y)\) 在(0,0)点处可微，故应选(D).
对于(A)，由 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f_x'(x,0) = f_x'(0,0),\lim_{y\to 0}f_y'(0,y) = f_y'(0,0)\) 说明 \(f_x'(x,0)\) 在 \(x = 0\) 处连续，\(f_y'(0,y)\) 在 \(y = 0\) 处连续.偏导数在某条特殊直线上的连续不能保证函数在该点可微.(A)不是充分条件.
对于(B)，只说明函数 \(f(x,y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 点连续，不能保证可微.
对于(C)，只能说明 \(f(x,y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 点关于 \(x,y\) 的偏导数 \(f_x'(0,0)\) 与 \(f_y'(0,0)\) 存在，不能保证可微.

10100288.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(f_{x}^{\prime}(0,0) = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x,0) - f(0,0)}{x} = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1 - 1}{x} = 0,\)
或 \(f_{x}^{\prime}(0,0) = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[f(x,0)]\Big|_{x = 0} = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(1)\Big|_{x = 0} = 0,\)
由对称性知 \(f_{y}^{\prime}(0,0) = 0\) ，则命题 ① 是正确的.
又 \(f_{x}^{\prime}(x,0) = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[f(x,0)] = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(1) = 0,\)
则 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f_x'(x,0) = 0 = f_x'(0,0),\)
由对称性知 \(\lim_{y\to 0}f_y'(0,y) = f_y'(0,0)\) ，则命题②也是正确的.
当 \(x \neq 0\) 时
\[
f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, 0) = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , y) - f (x , 0)}{y} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {x y - 1}{y} = \infty ,
\]
则 \(\lim_{(x,y)\to (0,0)}f_y'(x,y)\) 不存在，从而 \(f_y'(x,y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 点处不连续，由对称性知 \(f_x'(x,y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 点处不连续，则 ③ 不正确.
由于 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f(x,y) = \lim_{x\to 0}x^2 = 0.\) 而 \(f(0,0) = 1\) ，则 \(f(x,y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 点处不连续，从而 \(f(x,\) \(y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 点处不可微，则④不正确.故应选(B).

10100291.analysis_md:
【分析】利用一阶全微分形式不变性求 \(F(x,y,z) = 0\) 的全微分得
\[
\begin{array}{l} 0 = \mathrm{d} F (x, y, z) = F _ {x} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} x + F _ {y} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} y + F _ {z} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} z \\ = F _ {x} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} x + F _ {y} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} y + F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (z _ {x} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} x + z _ {y} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} y) \\ = \left(F _ {x} ^ {\prime} + F _ {z} ^ {\prime} z _ {x} ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm{d} x + \left(F _ {y} ^ {\prime} + F _ {z} ^ {\prime} z _ {y} ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm{d} y. \tag {*} \\ \end{array}
\]
在 \((\ast)\) 式令 \(x = 1, y = 1, z(1, 1) = 1\) 即得
\[
\begin{array}{l} 0 = \left[ - 2 + z _ {x} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (1, 1, 1) \right] \mathrm{d} x + \left[ 2 + 3 F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (1, 1, 1) \right] \mathrm{d} y. \\ \Leftrightarrow \left\{ \begin{array}{l} z _ {x} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (1, 1, 1) = 2, \\ 3 F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (1, 1, 1) = - 2. \end{array} \right. \\ \Rightarrow z _ {x} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) = \frac {2}{F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (1 , 1 , 1)} = 2 \times \left(- \frac {3}{2}\right) = - 3. \\ \end{array}
\]
故应选(A).
【评注】从以上有关多元复合函数与隐函数求偏导数的题目可见一阶全微分形式不变性是解决这类问题的十分简便且有效的工具,考生应当熟练掌握这种解题方法.

10100292.analysis_md:
【分析】 \( f_{y}^{\prime}(0,0)=\lim_{y\to0}\frac{f(0,y)-f(0,0)}{y}=\lim_{y\to0}\frac{0-0}{y}=0, \)
当 \(x \neq 0\) 时，
\[
f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, 0) = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , y) - f (x , 0)}{y} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {x \left(x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} = x,
\]
即 \(f_{y}^{\prime}(x,0) = x\) （对一切 \(\pmb{x}\) 都成立）.
\[
f _ {y x} ^ {\prime \prime} (0, 0) = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, 0) \Big | _ {x = 0} = 1,
\]
由对称性知 \(f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(0,0) = -1\) ，故应选(C).

10100294.analysis_md:
【分析】 由于
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} = 3 x ^ {2} - 8 x + 2 y = 0, \\ \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} = 2 x - 2 y = 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
的解为 \((0,0),(2,2)\). 只有 \((0,0)\) 在区域 \(D\) 内.
又因为 \(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime} = 6x - 8, B = f_{xy}^{\prime \prime} = 2, C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime} = -2\)，可得在点 \((0,0)\) 处 \(A = -8, AC - B^{2} > 0\)，所以点 \((0,0)\) 是极大值点.
注意 \(f(0,0) = 0\) ，在区域 \(D\) 的边界上点(4,1)处 \(f(4,1) = 7 > f(0,0)\) ，即 \(f(0,0)\) 不是\(f(x,y)\) 在区域 \(D\) 内的最大值，(0,0)不是 \(f(x,y)\) 在区域 \(D\) 内的最大值.因此选(B).
【评注】（1）本题考察当二元函数的两个偏导数都存在的条件下取得极值的必要条件和充分条件.
(2) 该题表明了多元函数与一元函数的一个区别: 区域 \(D\) 上的连续二元函数 \(f(x, y)\) 在 \(D\) 内有唯一的极值点, 若是极小 (大) 值点, 不一定是 \(f(x, y)\) 的最小 (大) 值点.

10100293.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 由题设知
\[
\frac {\partial f}{\partial x} = 2 y ^ {2} + 2 x y + 3 x ^ {2}, \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} = 4 x y + x ^ {2}.
\]
由 \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 2y^2 + 2xy + 3x^2\) 知
\[
f (x, y) = \int (2 y ^ {2} + 2 x y + 3 x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = 2 x y ^ {2} + x ^ {2} y + x ^ {3} + \varphi (y).
\]
由 \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = 4xy + x^2\) 知，\(4xy + x^2 = 4xy + x^2 + \varphi'(y), \varphi'(y) = 0, \varphi(y) = C\)，则
\[
f (x, y) = 2 x y ^ {2} + x ^ {2} y + x ^ {3} + C.
\]
方法2 \(\mathrm{d}f(x,y) = (2y^{2} + 2xy + 3x^{2})\mathrm{d}x + (4xy + x^{2})\mathrm{d}y\)
\[
= (2 y ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + 4 x y \mathrm{d} y) + (2 x y \mathrm{d} x + x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y) + 3 x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x
\]
\[
= \mathrm{d} (2 x y ^ {2}) + \mathrm{d} (x ^ {2} y) + \mathrm{d} x ^ {3},
\]
则 \(f(x,y) = 2xy^{2} + x^{2}y + x^{3} + C.\)
【评注】方法1是利用偏积分,方法2是利用凑微分.这两种方法是已知某个函数的全微分或两个一阶偏导数求原函数的两种常用方法.

10100295.analysis_md:
【分析】 \( y'(x) = -\frac{F_x'(x, y)}{F_y'(x, y)} \)，又 \( F_x'(x_0, y_0) = 0 \)，则 \( y'(x_0) = 0 \).
\[
y ^ {\prime \prime} (x) = - \frac {(F _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} + F _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} y ^ {\prime}) F _ {y} ^ {\prime} - (F _ {y x} ^ {\prime \prime} + F _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} y ^ {\prime}) F _ {x} ^ {\prime}}{(F _ {y} ^ {\prime}) ^ {2}},
\]
\[
y ^ {\prime \prime} (x _ {0}) = - \frac {F _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x _ {0} , y _ {0})}{F _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x _ {0} , y _ {0})}.
\]
若 \(F_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(x_0,y_0) < 0\) ，则 \(y''(x_0) > 0,x_0\) 是 \(y = y(x)\) 的极小值点，故应选(B).

10100290.analysis_md:
【分析】利用一阶全微分形式不变性,将方程组中每个方程两端求全微分,得
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \mathrm{d} x = \mathrm{d} u + z \mathrm{d} v + v \mathrm{d} z, \\ \mathrm{d} y = - 2 u \mathrm{d} u + \mathrm{d} v + \mathrm{d} z, \end{array} \right.
\]
由此可解出
\[
\begin{array}{l} \mathrm{d} u = \frac {1}{2 u x + 1} [ \mathrm{d} x - z \mathrm{d} y + (z - v) \mathrm{d} z ], \\ \mathrm{d} v = \frac {1}{2 u x + 1} [ 2 u \mathrm{d} x + \mathrm{d} y - (2 u v + 1) \mathrm{d} z ], \\ \end{array}
\]
从而
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac {1}{2 u x + 1}, \frac {\partial u}{\partial z} = \frac {x - v}{2 u x + 1}, \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} = \frac {1}{2 u x + 1}.
\]
在点(2,1,1)处 \(u(2,1,1)\) 与 \(v(2,1,1)\) 满足方程组
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u (2, 1, 1) + v (2, 1, 1) = 2, \\ u ^ {2} (2, 1, 1) - v (2, 1, 1) = 0, \end{array} \right.
\]
由此可解得满足 \(u(2,1,1) > 0\) 的函数值分别是 \(u(2,1,1) = v(2,1,1) = 1\) ，代入即得
\[
\left(\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial z}\right) \Big | _ {(2, 1, 1)} = \frac {z - v + 2}{2 u z + 1} \Big | _ {(2, 1, 1)} = \frac {2}{3},
\]
故应选(D).

10100297.analysis_md:
【分析】 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=2x-6\\\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}&=2y+8\end{aligned}\right. \) . 令 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=0,\\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}&=0,\end{aligned}\right. \) 得 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=3,\\ y&=-4.\end{aligned}\right. \)
点 \( (3,-4) \) 在圆域内，且 \( z(3,-4)=-25 \) .
函数在圆域的边界线 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 100\) 上的极值问题实际上是函数 \(z = x^{2} + y^{2} - 6x + 8y\) 在满足条件 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 100\) 下的极值问题.
可用拉格朗日乘数法求解.
作拉格朗日函数：
\[
F (x, y, \lambda) = x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 6 x + 8 y + \lambda (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 1 0 0).
\]

10100296.analysis_md:
【分析】 此问题归结为求函数
\[
u = x y z (x > 0, y > 0, z > 0)
\]
在条件 \(x + y + z = a\) 下的最大值.
方法 1 用拉格朗日乘数法.
令 \(F(x,y,z,\lambda) = xyz + \lambda (x + y + z - a),\)
解方程组
\[
\left(\frac {\partial F}{\partial x} = y z + \lambda = 0, \right.
\]
\[
\left. \frac {\partial F}{\partial y} = x z + \lambda = 0, \right.
\]
\[
\left(\frac {\partial F}{\partial z} = x y + \lambda = 0, \right.
\]
\[
\left(\frac {\partial F}{\partial \lambda} = x + y + z - a = 0, \right.
\]
第八章第三节
用 \(x, y, z\) 分别乘第一、二、三个方程得 \(x = y = z\), 再代入最后一个方程式得
\[
x = y = z = \frac {a}{3}.
\]
由题意最大值一定存在,因此当 \( x = y = z = \frac{a}{3} \) 时 u 取最大值 \( \left(\frac{a}{3}\right)^{3} = \frac{a^{3}}{27} \) .
方法 2 化为简单最值问题.
从条件 \(x + y + z = a\) 中解得 \(z = a - x - y\)，代入 \(u = xyz\) 得 \(u = xy(a - x - y)\)，转化为求函数 \(u = xy(a - x - y)\) 在开区域
\[
D = \{(x, y) \mid x > 0, y > 0, x + y < a \}
\]
中的最大值. 这个最大值一定存在, 它在 \(D\) 内的驻点处达到. 令
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = y (a - x - y) - x y = 0, \\ \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = x (a - x - y) - x y = 0, \end{array} \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = y, \\ 2 x + y = a, \end{array} \right. \right.
\]
解得 \(x = \frac{a}{3}, y = \frac{a}{3}\), 即 \(\left(\frac{a}{3}, \frac{a}{3}\right)\) 是唯一驻点, 也就是最大值点.
因此 \(u\) 的最大值是 \(u = \frac{a}{3} \cdot \frac{a}{3}\left(a - \frac{a}{3} - \frac{a}{3}\right) = \frac{a^3}{27}\).

10100302.analysis_md:

10100298.analysis_md:
【分析】引入极坐标 \(x = r\cos \theta, y = r\sin \theta\)，则 \(D = ((r, \theta) \left| -\frac{\pi}{2} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}, 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \cos \theta \right)\)，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} d \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\cos \theta} (r \cos \theta + r ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta) r d r \\ = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\frac {r ^ {3}}{3} \cos \theta + \frac {r ^ {4}}{4} \sin^ {2} \theta\right) \Bigg | _ {r = 0} ^ {r = \cos \theta} d \theta \\ = \frac {1}{3} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} \theta d \theta + \frac {1}{4} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} \theta \cos^ {4} \theta d \theta \\ = \frac {2}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} \theta d \theta + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (1 - \cos^ {2} \theta) \cos^ {4} \theta d \theta \\ = \left(\frac {2}{3} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} \theta d \theta - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {6} \theta d \theta \\ = \frac {7}{6} \cdot \frac {3}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {5}{6} \cdot \frac {3}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {9}{6 4} \pi . \\ \end{array}
\]

10100299.analysis_md:
【分析】从题设知 \(\iint_{D} y \, \mathrm{d}\sigma = \iint_{D_1} y \, \mathrm{d}\sigma - \iint_{D_2} y \, \mathrm{d}\sigma.\)
设 \(x = r\cos \theta, y = r\sin \theta\) 引入极坐标，在极坐标系 \((r, \theta)\) 中 \(D_{2}\) 可表示为 \((r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}, 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 2\cos \theta)\)，从而
\[
\iint_ {D _ {2}} y \mathrm{d} \sigma = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \cos \theta} r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d} r = \frac {8}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {3} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta = - \frac {2}{3} \cos^ {4} \theta \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} = \frac {2}{3}.
\]
记点(1,0)为N,则两个直角三角形△PMN与△OPQ相似,从而有
\[
\frac {P N}{P M} = \frac {P Q}{P O} \Leftrightarrow \frac {a - 1}{1} = \frac {\sqrt {2} a}{a} \Rightarrow a = 1 + \sqrt {2}.
\]
于是
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {D _ {1}} y \mathrm{d} \sigma = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {a - x} y \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {a} (a - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {1}{6} (a - x) ^ {3} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {a} \\ = \frac {a ^ {3}}{6} = \frac {(1 + \sqrt {2}) ^ {3}}{6} = \frac {1 + 3 \sqrt {2} + 3 \cdot 2 + 2 \sqrt {2}}{6} = \frac {7}{6} + \frac {5}{6} \sqrt {2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\iint_{D} y \, \mathrm{d}\sigma = \frac{7}{6} + \frac{5}{6} \sqrt{2} - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{5}{6} \sqrt{2}\), 即应选(D).

10100301.analysis_md:
【分析】由题设知 \(D = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1, y^2 \leqslant x \leqslant y\}\), 如图所示. 从而
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {D} \frac {\sin \pi y}{y} \mathrm{d} \sigma = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} y \int_ {y ^ {2}} ^ {y} \frac {\sin \pi y}{y} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\sin \pi y}{y} \mathrm{d} y \int_ {y ^ {2}} ^ {y} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - y) \sin \pi y \mathrm{d} y = - \frac {1}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - y) \mathrm{d} (\cos \pi y) \\ = - \frac {1}{\pi} \left[ (1 - y) \cos \pi y \right| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \cos \pi y d (1 - y) ] \\ = - \frac {1}{\pi} \left(- 1 + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \cos \pi y d y\right) = \frac {1}{\pi} - \frac {1}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \cos \pi y d y \\ = \frac {1}{\pi} - \frac {1}{\pi^ {2}} \sin \pi y \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{\pi}. \\ \end{array}
\]
故应选(C).

10100304.analysis_md:
【分析】由积分中值定理可知，D内至少存在一点 \((\xi, \eta)\)，使得
\[
\iint_ {D} \mathrm{e} ^ {x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}} \cos (x + y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \mathrm{e} ^ {\xi^ {2} - \eta^ {2}} \cos (\xi + \eta) \cdot \pi r ^ {2},

于是原式 \(= \lim_{r\to 0^{+}}\mathrm{e}^{\xi^{2} - \eta^{2}}\cos (\xi +\eta) = \lim_{(\xi ,\eta)\to (0,0)}(\mathrm{e}^{\xi^{2} - \eta^{2}}\cos (\xi +\eta) = 1.\) 故应选(B).

10100300.analysis_md:
【分析】对被积函数而言,先积 x 还是先积 y,繁简程度差别不大.但对积分区域 D,如右图,若先积 y 后积 x,D 的边界分段表示,要用分块积分法,不方便.选择先积 x 后积 y 的积分顺序则不必分块,D 的表示是:

D = \{(x, y) \mid 1 \leqslant y \leqslant 3, y - 1 \leqslant x \leqslant y \}.

\]

10100303.analysis_md:
【分析】显然 \(\iint_{D} f(u, v) \, \mathrm{d}u \, \mathrm{d}v\) 是一个常数，等式 \(f(x, y) = xy + \iint_{D} f(u, v) \, \mathrm{d}u \, \mathrm{d}v\) 两端积分得
\[
\iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \iint_ {D} x y \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y + \iint_ {D} f (u, v) \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v \cdot \iint_ {D} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y,
\]
28

\iint_ {D} x y \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2}} x y \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{1 2},
\]

\iint_ {D} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{3},

10100305.analysis_md:
【分析】首先确定被积函数,由于在极坐标系 \((r,\theta)\) 中面积元 \(\mathrm{d}\sigma = r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta\), 从而题设二重积分的被积函数应是 \(\frac{1}{r} f(r\cos \theta, r\sin \theta)\). 其次由题设知二重积分的积分区域 \(D\) 在极坐标系 \((r,\theta)\) 中的不等式表示是
\[
D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2}, \frac {1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta} \leqslant r \leqslant 1 \right\}.
\]
这表明 \(D\) 在满足 \(x = r\cos \theta, y = r\sin \theta\) 的直角坐标系 \(xOy\) 中位于第一象限，且内外边界分别是 \(r\cos \theta + r\sin \theta = 1\) （即 \(x + y = 1\)）与 \(r =\)
![](images/0.jpg)
1(即 \( x^{2}+y^{2}=1 \) ), 从而积分区域 \( D=\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant1,1-x\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\} \) ，如图所示. 故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {\frac {1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}} ^ {1} f (r \cos \theta , r \sin \theta) \mathrm{d} r = \iint_ {D} \frac {f (x , y)}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} \sigma \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {1 - x} ^ {\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \frac {f (x , y)}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} y. \\ \end{array}
\]

10100306.analysis_md:
【分析】因为 \(x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 2x + 2y \Leftrightarrow (x - 1)^{2} + (y - 1)^{2} \leqslant 2\)，从而可引入坐标轴的平移 \(x - 1 = u, y - 1 = v\) 即 \(x = u + 1, y = v + 1\)，这时区域 \(D = \{(x, y) \mid x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 2x + 2y\}\) 变为区域 \(D_{1} = \{(u, v) \mid u^{2} + v^{2} \leqslant 2\}\).
二重积分
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {D} (x ^ {2} + x y + y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} \sigma = \iint_ {D _ {1}} [ (u + 1) ^ {2} + (u + 1) (v + 1) + (v + 1) ^ {2} ] \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v \\ = \iint_ {D _ {1}} [ u ^ {2} + u v + v ^ {2} + 3 (u + v) + 3 ] d u d v \\ \end{array}
\]
\[
= \iint_ {D _ {1}} (u ^ {2} + v ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v + \iint_ {D _ {1}} [ u v + 3 (u + v) ] \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v + 3 \iint_ {D _ {1}} \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v.
\]
利用 \(D_{1}\) 关于 \(\pmb{u}\) 轴或 \(\pmb{v}\) 轴的对称性与函数 \(uv + 3(u + v)\) 关于 \(\pmb{v}\) 或 \(\pmb{u}\) 是奇函数的性质可得 \(\iint_{D_1} [uv + 3(u + v)] \mathrm{d}udv = 0\)，利用二重积分的几何意义可得 \(\iint_{D_1} \mathrm{d}udv = D_1\) 的面积 \(= 2\pi\).
最后，在 \(D_{1}\) 中引入极坐标 \(u = r\cos \theta, v = r\sin \theta\)，则 \(D_{1} = \{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi, 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \sqrt{2}\}\)，于是 \(\iint_{D_{1}} (u^{2} + v^{2}) \mathrm{d}u \mathrm{d}v = \int_{0}^{2\pi} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}} r^{2} \cdot r \mathrm{d}r = 2\pi \int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}} r^{3} \mathrm{d}r = \frac{\pi}{2} (\sqrt{2})^{4} = 2\pi.\)
故 \(\iint_{D_1}(x^2 + xy + y^2)\mathrm{d}\sigma = 2\pi +6\pi = 8\pi .\) 故应选(B).

10100307.analysis_md:
【分析】由于 \(x^{2}\int_{0}^{\sin x}\sqrt{1 - y^{2}}\mathrm{d}y\) 是 \(x\) 的奇函数， \(\cos x\int_0^{\sin x}y\sqrt{1 - y^2}\mathrm{d}y\) 是 \(x\) 的偶函数，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} = \frac {2}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (\cos x - \cos^ {4} x) d x \\ = \frac {2}{3} \left(1 - \frac {3}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2}\right) \\ = \frac {2}{3} - \frac {\pi}{8}. \\ \end{array}
\]
故应选(D).

10100309.analysis_md:
【分析】直接计算内层积分比较麻烦,应先将累次积分表成 \( \iint_{D}\sqrt{x^{2}-y^{2}}dxdy \) ,并求出D,然后交换积分顺序.显然
\[
D = \{(x, y) \mid y \leqslant x \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 \} = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant x, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \}.
\]
所以 \(I = \int_0^1\mathrm{d}y\int_y^1\sqrt{x^2 - y^2}\mathrm{d}x = \iint_D\sqrt{x^2 - y^2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\)
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{4} \pi x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {\pi}{1 2}.
\]
应选(D).

10100308.analysis_md:
【分析】引入极坐标 \((r,\theta)\) ，令 \(x = r\cos \theta ,y = r\sin \theta\) ，则
\[
D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid \frac {\pi}{6} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{3}, 1 \leqslant r \leqslant 3 \right\}, \arctan \frac {y}{x} = \theta ,
\]
故 \(\iint_{D} \arctan \frac{y}{x} \mathrm{d}\sigma = \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \theta \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{1}^{3} r \mathrm{d}r = \frac{\pi^2}{2} \left( \frac{1}{9} - \frac{1}{36} \right) \times \frac{1}{2} (9 - 1) = \frac{\pi^2}{6}\).

10100312.analysis_md:
【分析】用直线 \(x + y = 0\) 把区域 \(D\) 分割成关于直线 \(x + y = 0\) 对称的两个部分区域 \(D_{+} = \{(x,y) | (x,y) \in D\) 且 \(x + y \geqslant 0\} = \{(x,y) | -1 \leqslant x \leqslant 1, -x \leqslant y \leqslant 1\}\) 与 \(D_{-} = \{(x,y) | (x,y) \in D\) 且 \(x + y \leqslant 0\} = \{(x,y) | -1 \leqslant x \leqslant 1, -1 \leqslant y \leqslant -x\}\), 如图. 由于被积函数
\[
\mid x + y \mid = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x + y, & (x, y) \in D _ {+}, \\ - (x + y), & (x, y) \in D _ {-}, \end{array} \right.
\]
![](images/0.jpg)
从而用分块积分法可得
\[
\iint_ {D} | x + y | \mathrm{d} \sigma = \iint_ {D _ {+}} (x + y) \mathrm{d} \sigma + \iint_ {D _ {-}} [ - (x + y) ] \mathrm{d} \sigma = I _ {+} + I _ {-},
\]
分别计算 \(I_{+}\) 与 \(I_{-}\) 可得
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {D _ {+}} (x + y) \mathrm{d} \sigma = \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {- x} ^ {1} (x + y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (x y + \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}) \Big | _ {y = - x} ^ {y = 1} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (x + \frac {1}{2} + x ^ {2} - \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (1 + x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 + x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x \\ = 1 + \frac {1}{3} = \frac {4}{3}. \\ \end{array}
\]
\[
\iint_ {D _ {-}} [ - (x + y) ] \mathrm{d} \sigma = - \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {- 1} ^ {- x} (x + y) \mathrm{d} y = - \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (x y + \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}) \Big | _ {y = - 1} ^ {y = - x} \mathrm{d} x
\]
\[
= - \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (- x ^ {2} + \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + x - \frac {1}{2}) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (1 + x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {4}{3}.
\]
代入即知
\[
\iint_ {D} | x + y | \mathrm{d} \sigma = \frac {4}{3} + \frac {4}{3} = \frac {8}{3} = 2 \frac {2}{3}.
\]
应选(C).
【评注】由于积分区域 D 关于直线 \( x + y = 0 \) 对称, 而被积函数 \( f(x, y) = |x + y| \) 是关于 \( x + y \) 的偶函数, 所以直接可得
\[
\iint_ {D _ {+}} | x + y | \mathrm{d} \sigma = \iint_ {D _ {-}} | x + y | \mathrm{d} \sigma .
\]
故而， \(\iint_{D}|x + y|\mathrm{d}\sigma = 2\iint_{D_{+}}|x + y|\mathrm{d}\sigma = 2I_{+} = 2\times \frac{4}{3} = \frac{8}{3}.\)

10100311.analysis_md:
【分析】作坐标系的平移, 设 u = x, v = y - 2, 则区域 D 变为新直角坐标系 \( (u, v) \) 中的区域 \( D_{1} = \{(u, v) \mid u^{2} + v^{2} \leqslant 4\} \) , 且
\[
\iint_ {D} x ^ {2} y \mathrm{d} \sigma = \iint_ {D _ {1}} u ^ {2} (v + 2) \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v = \iint_ {D _ {1}} u ^ {2} v \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v + 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v.
\]
由于 \(D_{1}\) 关于 \(\pmb{u}\) 轴对称，而函数 \(u^{2}v\) 关于 \(\pmb{v}\) 是奇函数，从而
\[
\iint_ {D _ {1}} u ^ {2} v \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v = 0.
\]
而函数 \(u^2\) 分别关于 \(u\) 与 \(v\) 都是偶函数，从而又有
\[
\iint_ {D _ {1}} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v = 4 \iint_ {D _ {2}} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v.
\]
其中 \(D_{2}\) 是 \(D_{1}\) 在 \(u \geqslant 0, v \geqslant 0\) 的部分区域，即 \(D_{2} = \{(u, v) \mid 0 \leqslant u \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant v \leqslant \sqrt{4 - u^{2}}\}\)，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {D} x ^ {2} y \mathrm{d} \sigma = 8 \iint_ {D _ {2}} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} u \mathrm{d} v = 8 \int_ {0} ^ {2} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} u \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {4 - u ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} v \\ = 8 \int_ {0} ^ {2} u ^ {2} \sqrt {4 - u ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u \stackrel {u = 2 \sin \theta} {=} 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} 4 \sin^ {2} \theta \sqrt {4 - 4 \sin^ {2} \theta} \mathrm{d} (2 \sin \theta) \\ = 1 2 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} \theta \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta = 1 2 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} \theta (1 - \sin^ {2} \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta \\ \end{array}
\]
\[
= 1 2 8 \left(\int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {4} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta\right) = 1 2 8 \left(\frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2} - \frac {3}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2}\right) = 8 \pi .
\]
即应选(D).

10100310.analysis_md:
【分析】 由于
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = \iint_ {D} (2 - x) (2 - y) (1 - | x | - | y |) d \sigma \\ = 4 \iint_ {D} (1 - | x | - | y |) d \sigma - 2 \iint_ {D} x (1 - | x | - | y |) d \sigma \\ - 2 \iint_ {D} y (1 - | x | - | y |) d \sigma + \iint_ {D} x y (1 - | x | - | y |) d \sigma . \\ \end{array}
\]
其中后三个二重积分中的被积函数分别是关于 \(x\) 或关于 \(y\) 的奇函数，且积分区域 \(D\) 分别关于 \(y\) 轴或 \(x\) 轴对称，故后三个二重积
![](images/0.jpg)
分的积分值都是零. 在第一个二重积分中被积函数 \(1 - |x| - |y|\) 分别关于 \(x\) 或 \(y\) 是偶函数, 利用积分区域 \(D\) 分别关于 \(x\) 轴与 \(y\) 轴的对称性可得原二重积分
\[
I = \iint_ {D} (2 - x) (2 - y) (1 - | x | - | y |) \mathrm{d} \sigma = 1 6 \iint_ {D _ {1}} (1 - | x | - | y |) \mathrm{d} \sigma .
\]
其中 \(D_{1}\) 是区域 \(D\) 在第一象限部分，即 \(D_{1} = \{(x,y) \mid x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0, x + y \leqslant 1\} = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 - x\}\)，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = 1 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x} (1 - x - y) \mathrm{d} y \\ = 1 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ (1 - x) ^ {2} - \frac {(1 - x) ^ {2}}{2} \right] \mathrm{d} x = 8 \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \\ = - \frac {8}{3} (1 - x) ^ {3} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {8}{3}. \\ \end{array}
\]
即应选(D).

10100313.analysis_md:
【分析】令 \(x = r\cos \theta, y = r\sin \theta\)，在极坐标系 \((r, \theta)\) 中积分区域 \(D = \{(r, \theta) | 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}\}\)
\(\frac{1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta} \leqslant r \leqslant \frac{2}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}\), 从而
\[
\iint_ {D} \frac {\mathrm{d} \sigma}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {\frac {1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}} ^ {\frac {2}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}} \mathrm{d} r = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} \theta}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}. \tag {①}
\]
为计算 ①, 可作变换 \(\tan \frac{\theta}{2} = t\), 于是 \(\theta = 2\arctan t\), 从而 \(\mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{2\mathrm{d}t}{1 + t^2}, \sin \theta = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}, \cos \theta = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\), 且 \(\theta: 0 \to \frac{\pi}{2} \Leftrightarrow t: 0 \to 1\). 代入即得
![](images/0.jpg)
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} \theta}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} t}{1 + 2 t - t ^ {2}} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} t}{2 - (1 - t) ^ {2}},
\]
再令 \(1 - t = u\) ，即得
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} \theta}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} u}{2 - u ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\ln \frac {\sqrt {2} + u}{\sqrt {2} - u}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \ln \frac {\sqrt {2} + 1}{\sqrt {2} - 1} = \sqrt {2} \ln (\sqrt {2} + 1).
\]

10100314.analysis_md:
【分析】如按原积分次序不易积分,故可考虑先对 x 积分.又因为要由原累次积分的上下限得积分区域,但原题中内层积分下限大于上限,不符合二重积分定限原则,故利用定积分性质将积分上下限交换.从而
\[
I = \int_ {1} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {2} ^ {\frac {1}{3}} y \mathrm{e} ^ {x y} \mathrm{d} y = - \int_ {1} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {\frac {1}{y}} ^ {2} y \mathrm{e} ^ {x y} \mathrm{d} y.
\]
可得积分区域 \(D = \{(x, y) \mid \frac{1}{x} \leqslant y \leqslant 2, 1 \leqslant x \leqslant 2\}\). 交换积分次序, \(D\) 可写成 \(D = D_{1} + D_{2}\), 且
![](images/1.jpg)
\[
D _ {1} = \{(x, y) | \frac {1}{2} \leqslant y \leqslant 1, \frac {1}{y} \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \},
\]
\[
D _ {2} = \{(x, y) | 1 \leqslant y \leqslant 2, 1 \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \},
\]
从而
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = - \iint_ {D} y e ^ {2 y} d x d y = - \left(\int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} d y \int_ {\frac {1}{y}} ^ {2} y e ^ {2 y} d x + \int_ {1} ^ {2} d y \int_ {1} ^ {2} y e ^ {2 y} d x\right) \\ = - \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {2 y} - \mathrm{e}\right) \mathrm{d} y - \int_ {1} ^ {2} \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {2 y} - \mathrm{e} ^ {y}\right) \mathrm{d} y = - \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {4} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
\]

10100315.analysis_md:
【分析】方法1 三个积分区域 \(D_{1}, D_{2}\) 与 \(D_{3}\) 都是分别关于 \(x\) 轴与 \(y\) 轴对称的，记它们在第一象限的部分区域分别为 \(D_{11}, D_{21}\) 与 \(D_{31}\)，由于被积函数 \(|xy|\) 分别是自变量 \(x\) 与自变量 \(y\) 的偶函数，故有
\[
I _ {1} = 4 \iint_ {D _ {1 1}} | x y | \mathrm{d} \sigma = 4 \iint_ {D _ {1 1}} x y \mathrm{d} \sigma , I _ {2} = 4 \iint_ {D _ {2 1}} | x y | \mathrm{d} \sigma = 4 \iint_ {D _ {2 1}} x y \mathrm{d} \sigma ,
\]
\[
I _ {3} = 4 \iint_ {D _ {3 1}} | x y | \mathrm{d} \sigma = 4 \iint_ {D _ {3 1}} x y \mathrm{d} \sigma .
\]
其中 \(D_{11} = ((x,y)\mid 0\leqslant x\leqslant 1,0\leqslant y\leqslant \sqrt{1 - x^2}),D_{21} = ((x,y)\mid 0\leqslant x\leqslant 1,0\leqslant y\leqslant\)
\(\sqrt[4]{1 - x^4}), D_{31} = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 - x\}\), 从而
\[
I _ {1} = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} y \mathrm{d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x (1 - x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \left(\int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {3} \mathrm{d} x\right) = \frac {1}{2}.
\]
\[
I _ {2} = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt [ 4 ]{1 - x ^ {4}}} y \mathrm{d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \sqrt {1 - x ^ {4}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {4}} \mathrm{d} x ^ {2} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t
\]
\[
\stackrel {t = \sin \theta} {=} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {\pi}{4}.
\]
\[
I _ {3} = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x} y \mathrm{d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x (1 - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x (1 - 2 x + x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \left(\frac {1}{2} - \frac {2}{3} + \frac {1}{4}\right)
\]
\[
= 2 \left(\frac {3}{4} - \frac {2}{3}\right) = \frac {2}{1 2} = \frac {1}{6}.
\]
故 \(I_{3} < I_{1} < I_{2}\), 即应选(D).
方法2 可以不计算二重积分 \(I_{1}, I_{2}, I_{3}\) 的值而直接得出结论. 因为在 \(D_{11}, D_{21}\) 与 \(D_{31}\) 上被积函数同为 \(xy\) 且 \(xy \geqslant 0\) 并不恒等于零, 所以只需确定积分区域 \(D_{11}, D_{21}\) 与 \(D_{31}\) 的包含关系. 它们的左边界都是 \(y\) 轴上的区间 \([0,1]\), 下边界都是 \(x\) 轴上的区间 \([0,1]\), 而上边界则分别是圆弧 \(y = \sqrt{1 - x^2}\), 曲线段 \(y = \sqrt[4]{1 - x^4}\) 以及直线段 \(y = 1 - x\).
当 \(0 < x < 1\) 时，由 \(0 < x^4 < x^2 < x < 1\) 以及函数 \(y = \sqrt{x}\) 与 \(y = \sqrt[4]{x}\) 在[0,1]上单调增加可得
![](images/0.jpg)
\[
0 < 1 - x < 1 - x ^ {2} < \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} < \sqrt {1 - x ^ {4}} < \sqrt [ 4 ]{1 - x ^ {4}} < 1,
\]
即当 \(0 < x < 1\) 时有 \(0 < 1 - x < \sqrt{1 - x^2} < \sqrt[4]{1 - x^4} < 1\)，这表明 \(D_{11}, D_{21}\) 与 \(D_{31}\) 有如图的包含关系，故 \(I_3 < I_1 < I_2\).

10100317.analysis_md:
【分析】若 \(\int_0^{+\infty}f(x)\mathrm{d}x\) 收敛，则由反常积分的定义可知极限 \(\lim_{t\to +\infty}\int_0^t f(x)\mathrm{d}x\) 存在，由此可知极限 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\int_0^n f(x)\mathrm{d}x\) 存在，即
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \dots + \int_ {n - 1} ^ {n} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right]
\]
存在,由级数定义可知, \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\int_{n-1}^{n}f(x)\mathrm{d}x \) 收敛,故当级数 \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\int_{n-1}^{n}f(x)\mathrm{d}x \) 发散时, \( \int_{0}^{+\infty}f(x)\mathrm{d}x \) 必发散,选(C).

10100320.analysis_md:
【分析】因为 \( |(-1)^{n-1}u_n| = |u_n| = u_n \)，由 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} u_n\) 收敛知 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} u_n\) 绝对收敛，命题 (D) 正确.
【评注】（A）错误，例如级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \frac{1}{n^2}\) 收敛，并且是绝对收敛的.
(B) 和 (C) 也是错误的, 例如级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{n}\) 收敛, 但级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}\) 发散.

10100321.analysis_md:
【分析】由 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n\) 的收敛域是 \((-8, 8]\) 可知，幂级数 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n\) 的收敛半径是 8，从而幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n x^{n-2}\) 的收敛半径也是 8。又因幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{a_n x^n}{n(n-1)}\) 是由幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n x^{n-2}\) 两次逐项求积分所得（或 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{a_n x^n}{n(n-1)}\) 两次求导得幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n x^{n-2}\)），由幂级数和函数的性质可得，幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{a_n x^n}{n(n-1)}\) 的收敛半径也是8。幂级数 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^{3n} = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n (x^3)^n\) 的收敛域是 \(-8 < x^3 \leqslant 8\) 即 \(-2 < x \leqslant 2\)。
【评注】（1）应掌握幂级数收敛性的如下特点：幂级数 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n\) 与其逐项求导或逐项求积分后的幂级数
\[
\sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} (a _ {n} x ^ {n}) ^ {\prime} = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} n a _ {n} x ^ {n - 1}, \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} a _ {n} t ^ {n} \mathrm{d} t = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{n + 1} x ^ {n + 1}
\]
有相同的收敛半径.
本题还考察间接求幂级数的收敛域的方法.
(2) 求幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{a_n x^n}{n(n-1)}\) 的收敛半径时, 以下解法虽可选出正确选项, 但理论根据却是错误的:
由 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n\) 的收敛域是 \((-8, 8]\) 可知，幂级数 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n\) 的收敛半径是 8，所以 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{a_{n+1}}{a_n} \right| = \frac{1}{8}\)，从而 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{(n-1)na_{n+1}}{n(n+1)a_n} \right| = \frac{1}{8}\)，于是幂级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{a_n x^n}{n(n-1)}\) 的收敛半径是 8。错误之处在于，因为已知的定理是：若 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{u_{n+1}}{u_n} \right| = \rho \Rightarrow \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} u_n x^n\) 的收敛半径为 \(R = \frac{1}{\rho}\)，但反过来不一定对，即若 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} u_n x^n\) 的收敛半径为 \(R\)，则不一定有 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{u_{n+1}}{u_n} \right| = \frac{1}{R}\)。因为极限 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{u_{n+1}}{u_n} \right|\) 可能存在，因此前面的解法是增加了条件即假设 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{u_{n+1}}{u_n} \right|\) 存在的前提下获得的结果。

10100316.analysis_md:
【分析】令 \(a_{n} = \frac{(-1)^{n}}{n}\), 则级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{n}\) 是收敛的, 且是条件收敛, 因此级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{|a_{n}| + a_{n}}{2}\) 和 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{|a_{n}| - a_{n}}{2}\) 都是发散的, 从而命题 ① 不正确.
令 \(a_{n} = \frac{-1}{n}\), 显然级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} |a_{n}|\) 是发散的, 但级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{|a_{n}| + a_{n}}{2}\) 是收敛的, 从而命题 ② 不正确.
若 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}|a_n|\) 收敛，则 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{|a_n| + a_n}{2}\) 和 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{|a_n| - a_n}{2}\) 都收敛，由此可知命题 ③ 是正确的。由于当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n\) 绝对收敛时，\(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{|a_n| + a_n}{2}\) 和 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{|a_n| - a_n}{2}\) 都收敛。当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n\) 条件收敛时，\(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{|a_n| + a_n}{2}\) 和 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{|a_n| - a_n}{2}\) 都发散，由此可知命题④是正确的。故应选(C).

10100319.analysis_md:
【分析】正项级数 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n\) 收敛 \(\Rightarrow \lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = 0, \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n}\) 也收敛.
\[
\mid b _ {n} \mid = \ln (1 + a _ {2 n}) \sim a _ {2 n} \quad (n \rightarrow \infty)
\]
由 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n}\) 收敛 \(\Rightarrow \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} |b_n|\) 收敛. 因此选(B).
【评注】正项级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 收敛 \(\Rightarrow\) 部分和 \(S_n = a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n\) 有界，即 \(0 \leqslant S_n \leqslant M\) (\(n = 1, 2, 3, \cdots\)) \(\Rightarrow \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n}\) 的部分和 \(T_n = a_2 + a_4 + \cdots + a_{2n} \leqslant S_{2n} \leqslant M (n = 1, 2, 3, \cdots)\)，即 \(\{T_n\}\) 有界 \(\Rightarrow \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n}\) 收敛（正项级数收敛的充要条件是部分和有界）。同理 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n-1}\) 也收敛。

10100322.analysis_md:
【分析】由于 \(\sqrt[n]{\frac{1}{n}}\leqslant \sqrt[n]{\frac{1 + \frac{1}{2}\cdots + \frac{1}{n}}{n}}\leqslant \sqrt[n]{\frac{n}{n}}\) ，则
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sqrt [ n ]{\frac {1 + \frac {1}{2} \cdots + \frac {1}{n}}{n}} = 1,
\]
幂级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1 + \frac{1}{2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{n}}{n} x^n\) 的收敛半径为 1.
当 \(x = -1\) 时，级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^n \frac{1 + \frac{1}{2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{n}}{n}\) 为交错级数，且满足莱布尼茨准则的两个条件，则该级数收敛.
当 \(x = 1\) 时，级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1 + \frac{1}{2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{n}}{n}\) 显然是发散的，故幂级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1 + \frac{1}{2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{n}}{n} x^n\) 的收敛域为 \([-1, 1)\)，选(D).

10100323.analysis_md:
【分析】 方法1 分解法,转化为用公式 \( \ln(1+x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^{n-1}x^{n}}{n}(-1<x\leqslant1) \) .
\[
S (x) = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \left(\frac {1}{n} - \frac {1}{n + 1}\right) x ^ {n},
\]
\[
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n}}{n} = - \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(- 1) ^ {n - 1} (- x) ^ {n}}{n} = - \ln (1 - x) (- 1 \leqslant x < 1),
\]
\[
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n}}{n + 1} = \frac {1}{x} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n + 1}}{n + 1} = \frac {1}{x} \left(\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n}}{n} - x\right)
\]
\[
= - \frac {1}{x} \ln (1 - x) - 1 \quad (- 1 \leqslant x < 1, x \neq 0),
\]
故而，有
\[
S (x) = - \ln (1 - x) + \frac {1}{x} \ln (1 - x) + 1. \quad (- 1 \leqslant x < 1, x \neq 0).
\]
应选(C).
方法 2 逐项求导两次,转化为几何级数求和
\[
x S (x) = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n + 1}}{n (n + 1)} \Rightarrow (x S (x)) ^ {\prime \prime} = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} x ^ {n - 1} = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} x ^ {n} = \frac {1}{1 - x} (| x | < 1),
\]
\[
(x S (x)) ^ {\prime} = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{1 - t} = - \ln (1 - x),
\]
\[
x S (x) = - \int_ {0} ^ {x} \ln (1 - t) \mathrm{d} t = - t \ln (1 - t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {x} + \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {- t + 1 - 1}{1 - t} \mathrm{d} t
\]
\[
= - x \ln (1 - x) + x + \ln (1 - x) \quad (| x | < 1),
\]
故而，有
\[
S (x) = - \ln (1 - x) + \frac {1}{x} \ln (1 - x) + 1 \quad (- 1 \leqslant x < 1, x \neq 0).
\]
(右端函数在 x = -1 右连续, 左端级数 \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{x^{n+1}}{n(n+1)} \) 在 x = -1 收敛, 故 x = -1 时等式也成立.)
【评注】(1) \( S(0)=0. \)
(2) \( S(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{x^{n}}{n(n+1)}=-\ln(1-x)+\frac{1}{x}\ln(1-x)+1(-1\leqslant x<1,x\neq0) \) ,
左端级数在 x=1 收敛，
\[
S (1) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} [ - \ln (1 - x) + \frac {1}{x} \ln (1 - x) + 1 ] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {1}{x} (1 - x) \ln (1 - x) + 1 = 1,
\]
因此 \(S(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{x} (1 - x)\ln (1 - x) + 1, & -1\leqslant x < 1,x\neq 0\\ 0, & x = 0.\\ 1, & x = 1 \end{array} \right.\)

10100325.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(a_{n} = \frac{2}{1}\int_{0}^{1}x\cos n\pi x\mathrm{d}x = \frac{2}{n\pi}\int_{0}^{1}x\mathrm{d}\sin n\pi x\)
\[
= \frac {2}{n \pi} x \sin n \pi x \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {2}{n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sin n \pi x d x
\]
\[
= 2 \frac {(- 1) ^ {n} - 1}{n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} (n = 1, 2, \dots).
\]
则 \(a_{2n - 1} = \frac{-4}{(2n - 1)^2\pi^2}.\)
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n ^ {2} a _ {2 n - 1} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {- 4 n ^ {2}}{(2 n - 1) ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} = - \frac {1}{\pi^ {2}},
\]
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} (1 + a _ {2 n - 1}) ^ {n ^ {2}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\alpha^ {2}}}.
\]
故应选(C).

10100324.analysis_md:
【分析】题中给出 \( f(x) \) 在 \( [0,1] \) 中的值，由于和函数 \( S(x) \) 是周期为 2 的奇函数，可将求 \( S\left(-\frac{5}{2}\right) \) 转化为求 \( S(x) \) 在 \( [0,1] \) 中的某点的值
\[
\begin{array}{l} S \left(- \frac {5}{2}\right) = S \left(- \frac {5}{2} + 2\right) = S \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) = - S \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) = - \frac {f \left(\frac {1}{2} - 0\right) + f \left(\frac {1}{2} + 0\right)}{2} \\ = - \frac {\frac {3}{2} + \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right)}{2} = - \frac {1}{2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
故应选(B).

10100326.analysis_md:
【分析】对于(B)，用反证法验证(B)正确.如果 \(\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}b_n\) 收敛，由
\[
\mid a _ {n} \mid \leqslant b _ {n}
\]
知， \(\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}|a_n|\) 收敛，从而 \(\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}a_n\) 收敛与题设矛盾，故应选(B).

10100328.analysis_md:
【分析】由于数列 \(\{a_{n}\}\) 满足 \(a_1 \geqslant a_2 \geqslant \cdots \geqslant a_n \geqslant \cdots > 0\)，从而数列 \(\{a_n\}\) 必存在极限，若 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = 0\)，则必有交错级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} a_n\) 收敛，与题设条件矛盾。从而存在常数 \(a > 0\) 使得 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = a\)，且 \(a_n \geqslant a > 0 (n = 1, 2, 3, \cdots)\)，则
\[
\frac {1}{a _ {n} + 1} \leqslant \frac {1}{a + 1} < 1 (n = 1, 2, 3, \dots),
\]
进而 \(\left|(-1)^{n - 1}\left(\frac{1}{a_n + 1}\right)^n\right| = \left(\frac{1}{a_n + 1}\right)^n\leqslant \left(\frac{1}{a + 1}\right)^n.\)
又 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(\frac{1}{a+1}\right)^n\) 收敛，故级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n-1}\left(\frac{1}{a_n+1}\right)^n\) 绝对收敛，应选(C).

10100329.analysis_md:
【分析】可求得:幂级数 \( \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{(x-a)^{n}}{\ln(n+2)} \) 的收敛半径为 R=1. 而由幂级数 \( \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{(x-a)^{n}}{\ln(n+2)} \) 在点 x=-2 条件收敛可得, 此幂级数的收敛半径又为 \( |-2-a| \) . 所以 \( 2+a=\pm1 \) , 故 a=-1 或 a=-3.
又因为幂级数 \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(x-a)^n}{(n+2)^2}\) 的收敛半径为 1, 所以当 \(|x-a| > 1\) 时, 对应的级数发散, 由于不论 \(a = -1\) 或 \(a = -3\), 都有 \(\left|\frac{1}{2} - a\right| > 1\), 所以应选 (C).

10100327.analysis_md:
【分析】这里级数的一般项中含有三种类型的无穷大量.
\[
n ^ {\mu} (\mu > 0), q ^ {n} (q > 1), \ln^ {\delta} n (\delta > 0),
\]
其中 \(n \to \infty\)，它们的关系是
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {n ^ {\mu}}{q ^ {n}} = 0, \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\ln^ {\delta} n}{n ^ {\mu}} = 0.
\]
现考察此正项级数的一般项：
\[
\frac {n ^ {\gamma} + a ^ {n}}{n ^ {\alpha} + \ln^ {\beta} n + \gamma^ {n}} = \frac {\alpha^ {n} \left(1 + \frac {n ^ {\gamma}}{\alpha^ {n}}\right)}{\gamma^ {n} \left(1 + \frac {\ln^ {\beta} n}{\gamma^ {n}} + \frac {n ^ {\alpha}}{\gamma^ {n}}\right)} \sim \left(\frac {\alpha}{\gamma}\right) ^ {n} (n \rightarrow \infty)
\]
这里 \(a_{n}\sim b_{n}(n\to \infty)\) ，即 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{a_n}{b_n} = 1.\)
\[
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \left(\frac {\alpha}{\gamma}\right) ^ {n} \text {收敛} \Leftrightarrow \frac {\alpha}{\gamma} < 1 \text {即} \alpha < \gamma .
\]
因此,原级数收敛 \( \Leftrightarrow\alpha<\gamma \) . 故应选(B).

10100331.analysis_md:
【分析】因当 \(n \geqslant 2\) 时 \(\left| (-1)^{n-1} \frac{\ln(n+1)}{n} \right| \geqslant \frac{1}{n}\) 且级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}\) 发散，从而级数①非绝对收敛；令 \(f(x) = \frac{\ln(x+1)}{x}\)，于是 \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln(x+1)}{x} = \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{1}{x+1} = 0\)
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {1}{x (x + 1)} - \frac {\ln (x + 1)}{x ^ {2}} = - \frac {1}{x (x + 1)} [ (1 + \frac {1}{x}) \ln (x + 1) - 1 ] < 0
\]
当 \(x \geqslant 2\) 时成立, 这表明 \(\left\{\frac{\ln(n+1)}{n}\right\}\) 当 \(n \geqslant 2\) 时单调减少且 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{\ln(n+1)}{n} = 0\), 由莱布尼茨判别法知级数 ① 收敛. 综合即知级数 ① 条件收敛.
因 \(\sin \left(n\pi + \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\right) = (-1)^n \sin \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\)，且 \(\left|(-1)^n \sin \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\right| = \sin \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \sim \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\)，从而由 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\) 发散知级数 ④ 非绝对收敛；因 \(\left\{\sin \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\right\}\) 单调减少且 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} = 0\)，由莱布尼茨判别法知级数 ④ 收敛。综合即知级数 ④ 条件收敛。
因 \(\left|(-1)^{n-1} \frac{n}{2^n}\right| \leqslant \frac{n}{2^n}\), 又令 \(u_n = \frac{n}{2^n} (n = 1, 2, \cdots)\) 可得 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{u_{n+1}}{u_n} = \frac{1}{2} \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n+1}{n} = \frac{1}{2} < 1\), 故由比值判别法知级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n}{2^n}\) 收敛, 即级数 ② 绝对收敛.
因 \(\frac{(-1)^{n - 1}}{\sqrt{n} - (-1)^n} = (-1)^{n - 1}\frac{\sqrt{n} + (-1)^n}{n - 1} = (-1)^{n - 1}\frac{\sqrt{n}}{n - 1} -\frac{1}{n - 1},\)
而级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \frac{\sqrt{n}}{n-1}\) 条件收敛, 级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n-1}\) 发散, 故级数 ③ 发散.
从上面讨论可得仅级数 ①④ 条件收敛, 应选(D).

10100330.analysis_md: 【分析】考查幂级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n x^n\)，由于 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^n a_n 2^n\) 收敛，所以幂级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n x^n\) 在 \(x = -2\) 点收敛，根据阿贝尔定理可得：当 \(|x| < |-2|\) 时，对应的级数都绝对收敛，所以当 \(x = 1\) 时，对应的级数绝对收敛，而此时对应的级数为 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\). 所以应选(B).

10100332.analysis_md:
【分析】由于 \(\frac{1}{\ln n!} = \frac{1}{\ln 2 + \ln 3 + \cdots + \ln n} > \frac{1}{n\ln n} (n > 2)\). 而由积分判别法可知级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n\ln n}\) 发散, 则级数 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{1}{\ln(n!)}\) 发散.
级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(2 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n^22^n}\right)\) 与级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(2 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n\frac{1}{n^22^n}\) 同敛散，又
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\left(2 + \frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {n} \frac {1}{n ^ {2} 2 ^ {n}}}{\frac {1}{n ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(1 + \frac {1}{2 n}\right) ^ {n} = \sqrt {\mathrm{e}},
\]
则级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(2 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n^22^n}\right)\) 收敛.
\[
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(- 2) ^ {n} n ^ {2} + \mathrm{e} ^ {n}}{n \mathrm{e} ^ {n}} = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \left[ n \left(\frac {- 2}{\mathrm{e}}\right) ^ {n} + \frac {1}{n} \right],
\]
级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n\left(\frac{-2}{\mathrm{e}}\right)^n\) 收敛, \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}\) 发散, 则级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-2)^n n^2 + \mathrm{e}^n}{n \mathrm{e}^n}\) 发散.
由于 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\sqrt[n]{\left|\frac{(-1)^n\mathrm{e}^n}{3^n - 2^n}\right|} = \frac{\mathrm{e}}{3}\lim_{n\to \infty}\sqrt[n]{\frac{1}{1 - \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^n}} = \frac{\mathrm{e}}{3} < 1\) ，则级数 \(\sum_{n = 2}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^n\mathrm{e}^n}{3^n - 2^n}\) 收敛，故应选(C).

10034802.analysis_md:
解 由 Ax = 0, 得 \( A^{T}Ax = A^{T}(Ax) = 0 \) , 故 Ax = 0 的解是 \( A^{T}Ax = 0 \) 的解.

反之，若 \(x\) 是 \(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解，令 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}\) ，则 \(b^{\mathrm{T}} = (\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x})^{\mathrm{T}} = \mathbf{x}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\) ，从而

$$\boldsymbol {b} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {b} = \boldsymbol {x} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {x} = \boldsymbol {0},$$

于是 b 的各分量的平方和为 0，故 b = 0，从而 Ax = 0，因此 \( A^{T}Ax = 0 \) 的解是 Ax = 0 的解.

【注】证明列向量 b = 0，即证 b 的每个分量为 0，可证 \( b^{T}b = 0 \) ，这是证明向量为零向量的一种方法.

wrong_options.B: 只考虑了 $Ax=0$ 的解是 $A^TAx=0$ 的解，忽略了反向证明，误以为反向不成立。
wrong_options.C: 完全忽略了 $Ax=0$ 的解必是 $A^TAx=0$ 的解这一基本事实。
wrong_options.D: 只考虑了反向，忽略了正向，误以为 $Ax=0$ 的解不是 $A^TAx=0$ 的解。

pitfalls: 容易只证一个方向，忽略反向证明，误选 B 或 D。
在证明反向时，可能忘记利用 $b^Tb=0$ 推出 $b=0$，而试图直接解方程组，导致思路受阻。
可能混淆 $A^TA$ 与 $AA^T$，错误地认为 $A^TAx=0$ 与 $Ax=0$ 不等价。
10034802.key_point: 本题关键在于证明两个齐次方程组同解。一方面由 $Ax=0$ 直接左乘 $A^T$ 得 $A^TAx=0$；另一方面，若 $A^TAx=0$，令 $b=Ax$，则 $b^Tb=x^TA^TAx=0$，由 $b^Tb$ 为各分量平方和推出 $b=0$，即 $Ax=0$。

10100334.analysis_md:
【分析】由于 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{\left(\frac{na}{n + 1}\right)^n}{\frac{a^n}{e}} = 1\) 且 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{a^n}{e} = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & 0 < a < 1,\\ \frac{1}{e}, & a = 1,\\ + \infty , & a > 1, \end{array} \right.\)
则当 \(a \geqslant 1\) 时，\(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left( \frac{na}{n + 1} \right)^n \neq 0\)，故当 \(a \geqslant 1\) 时原级数发散。选(D).
【评注】当 \(0 < a < 1\) 时，由
\[
\left(\frac {n a}{n + 1}\right) ^ {n} \sim \frac {1}{\mathrm{e}} a ^ {n} (n \rightarrow \infty)
\]
以及 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{e} a^n\) 收敛可知原级数收敛.

10100333.analysis_md:
【分析】由泰勒公式可得
\[
\ln \left(1 + \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{\sqrt {n}}\right) = \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{\sqrt {n}} - \frac {1}{2 n} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right).
\]
由于级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}}\) 收敛, 级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \left[-\frac{1}{2n} + o\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)\right]\) 发散, 则级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \ln \left(1 + \frac{(-1)^n}{n}\right)\) 发散, 又级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{n^p} (p > 0)\) 收敛, 则原级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \left[\ln \left(1 + \frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}}\right) - \frac{(-1)^n}{n^p}\right] (p > 0)\) 发散, 故选(A).

10100335.analysis_md: 【分析】若 \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{(p - 2)x}\mathrm{d}x\) 和 \(\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^n}{n^p}\) 均收敛，则同时有 \(p - 2 < 0\) 且 \(p > 0\) ，综合得\(0 < p < 2.\) 故选(D).

10100336.analysis_md:
【分析】 \(\int_0^{\frac{1}{n}}\frac{x^\alpha\mathrm{d}x}{x + x^{\alpha + 1}} = \int_0^{\frac{1}{n}}\frac{x^{\alpha - 1}\mathrm{d}x}{1 + x^\alpha} = \frac{1}{\alpha}\int_0^{\frac{1}{n}}\frac{\mathrm{d}(1 + x^\alpha)}{1 + x^\alpha} = \frac{1}{\alpha}\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n^\alpha}\right),\)
\[
\begin{array}{l} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} (- 1) ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{n} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{n}} \frac {x ^ {\alpha} \mathrm{d} x}{x + x ^ {\alpha + 1}}\right) = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} (- 1) ^ {n} \left[ \frac {1}{n} - \frac {1}{\alpha} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n ^ {\alpha}}\right) \right] \\ = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{n} - \frac {1}{\alpha} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} (- 1) ^ {n} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n ^ {2}}\right). \\ \end{array}
\]
级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{n}\) 条件收敛. 当 \(\alpha > 1\) 时, 级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^n \ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n^\alpha}\right)\) 绝对收敛, 则原级数条件收敛; 当 \(\alpha = 1\) 时, 原级数为 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^n \left[ \frac{1}{n} - \ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right) \right]\) 绝对收敛. 故应选(D).

10034807.analysis_md:
解 由 AB = E，知 \( r(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}) = m \) 。又由 \( r(\mathbf{A}) \geqslant r(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}) = m \) ，且 \( r(\mathbf{A}) \leqslant m \) ，知

$$\mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A}) = m,$$

即 A 的行向量组线性无关, 从而其延伸组必线性无关. 故 \( r(A) = r(A, \alpha) = m \) .

方程组 AX = \( \alpha \) 必有解, 但是有唯一解, 还是有无穷多解, 不确定.

同理可得 \( r(B)=m \) ，即 B 的列向量组线性无关，BX=0 仅有零解。

此时， \( r(B,\beta) \) 有可能为 \( m+1,BX=\beta \) 可能无解，从而排除选项 A,B,C.

故选项 D 正确.

wrong_options.A: 认为 $AB=E$ 意味着 $A$ 和 $B$ 都可逆，从而两个非齐次方程组都有唯一解，但 $m,n$ 不一定相等，$A$ 和 $B$ 不一定是方阵。
wrong_options.B: 由 $r(A)=m$ 误以为 $AX=\alpha$ 有无穷多解，但 $n$ 可能等于 $m$，此时可能唯一解；且 $BX=\beta$ 可能无解。
wrong_options.C: 由 $r(A)=m$ 误以为 $AX=0$ 仅有零解，但 $A$ 是 $m\times n$ 矩阵，当 $n>m$ 时 $AX=0$ 必有非零解；$BX=0$ 确实仅有零解，但整体错误。

pitfalls: 误认为 $AB=E$ 推出 $A$ 和 $B$ 都可逆，从而 $AX=\alpha$ 和 $BX=\beta$ 都有唯一解，忽略 $m,n$ 可能不等。
由 $r(A)=m$ 只保证 $AX=\alpha$ 有解，不能推出唯一解，需结合 $n$ 与 $m$ 的关系判断。
由 $r(B)=m$ 推出 $BX=0$ 仅有零解时，误以为 $BX=\beta$ 也有解，忽略 $\beta$ 可能不在 $B$ 的列空间中。
10034807.key_point: 由 $AB=E$ 得 $r(A)=m$，故 $A$ 行满秩，$AX=\alpha$ 必有解；由 $r(B)=m$ 得 $B$ 列满秩，$BX=0$ 仅有零解。关键是利用秩不等式 $r(A)\ge r(AB)$ 和秩的定义。

10100337.analysis_md:
【分析】 级数(1)用分解通项法,可得其通项
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{\sqrt {n + 1} + (- 1) ^ {n}} = \frac {(- 1) ^ {n} [ \sqrt {n + 1} - (- 1) ^ {n} ]}{n + 1 - 1} \\ = (- 1) ^ {n} \frac {\sqrt {n + 1}}{n} - \frac {1}{n} \\ = (- 1) ^ {n} \frac {\sqrt {n + 1} - \sqrt {n}}{n} + \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{\sqrt {n}} - \frac {1}{n} \\ = \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{n (\sqrt {n + 1} + \sqrt {n})} + \frac {(- 1) ^ {n}}{\sqrt {n}} - \frac {1}{n}. \\ \end{array}
\]
由莱布尼茨判别法即知交错级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{n(\sqrt{n+1} + \sqrt{n})}\) 与 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}}\) 都收敛, 但调和级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}\) 发散. 从而交错级数 (1) 作为两个收敛级数与一个发散级数的和级数必发散.
级数(2)可改写为
\[
\begin{array}{l} \sin (\pi \sqrt {n ^ {2} + 1}) = \sin [ (\sqrt {n ^ {2} + 1} - n) \pi + n \pi ] \\ = \sin (\sqrt {n ^ {2} + 1} - n) \pi \cdot \cos n \pi + \cos (\sqrt {n ^ {2} + 1} - n) \pi \cdot \sin n \pi \\ = (- 1) ^ {n} \sin (\sqrt {n ^ {2} + 1} - n) \pi = (- 1) ^ {n} \sin \frac {\pi}{\sqrt {n ^ {2} + 1} + n}, \\ \end{array}
\]
由此即知级数(2)是交错级数,由莱布尼茨判别法可知级数(2)收敛.
综合知应选(C).

10100340.analysis_md:
【分析】由题设可知 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n x^n = x^2 e^x\)，则 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n x^{n-1} = x e^x\).
\[
\sum_ {n = 2} ^ {\infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{n} x ^ {n} = \int_ {0} ^ {x} t e ^ {t} \mathrm{d} t = x e ^ {x} - e ^ {x} + 1.
\]
令 \(x = 1\) 得 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{a_n}{n} = 1\).
令 \(x = -1\) 得 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n a_n}{n} = 1 - \frac{2}{\mathrm{e}}.\)
\[
\sum_ {n = 2} ^ {\infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{n} + \sum_ {n = 2} ^ {\infty} \frac {(- 1) ^ {n} a _ {n}}{n} = 2 \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {a _ {2 n}}{2 n} = 2 - \frac {2}{\mathrm{e}}.
\]
故 \(\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}\frac{a_{2n}}{n} = 2\left(1 - \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right),\)
选(A).
